# DMS2 對比 DMS1：完整定義差異附錄

基準：DMS1 1.8.27（1.6 內容）→ DMS2 2.0.3（HEAD）。含選用模組及抽象父定義；不等同遊戲內物品數。XML 註解、欄位順序亦會列為修改；數值為原始定義，未展開繼承或套用 Patch。

## 新增（654）

### AbilityDef:DMS_BF_RecoillessShot — Recoilless Rifle Shot

來源：`1.7/Defs/Abilities/Common.xml`

```xml
<AbilityDef>
		<defName>DMS_BF_RecoillessShot</defName>
		<label>Recoilless Rifle Shot</label>
		<description>Fire one of the rack's 65mm shaped-charge rockets. The jet defeats armor and fortification that the frame's own weapon cannot touch, but it goes into a single narrow channel and does little to anything standing beside the point of impact.\n\nSpent tubes are reloaded from the frame's carried stores between engagements.</description>
		<iconPath>UI/Ability/Missile</iconPath>
		<aiCanUse>true</aiCanUse>
		<hostile>true</hostile>
		<cooldownTicksRange>30000</cooldownTicksRange>
		<charges>2</charges>
		<cooldownPerCharge>true</cooldownPerCharge>
		<verbProperties>
			<verbClass>Verb_CastAbility</verbClass>
			<label>fire recoilless rifle</label>
			<defaultCooldownTime>3</defaultCooldownTime>
			<onlyManualCast>false</onlyManualCast>
			<range>29.9</range>
			<warmupTime>2</warmupTime>
			<requireLineOfSight>true</requireLineOfSight>
			<soundCast>RocketswarmLauncher_Fire</soundCast>
			<soundCastTail>GunTail_Heavy</soundCastTail>
			<ai_IsBuildingDestroyer>true</ai_IsBuildingDestroyer>
			<ai_AvoidFriendlyFireRadius>5</ai_AvoidFriendlyFireRadius>
			<targetParams>
				<canTargetPawns>true</canTargetPawns>
				<canTargetLocations>true</canTargetLocations>
				<canTargetBuildings>true</canTargetBuildings>
			</targetParams>
		</verbProperties>
		<comps>
			<li Class="CompProperties_AbilityLaunchProjectile">
				<projectileDef>DMS_Bullet_LRR_HEAT</projectileDef>
			</li>
		</comps>
	</AbilityDef>


```

### AbilityDef:DMS_FrogmanRationRecovery — Metabolic Surge

來源：`1.7/Defs/Abilities/Frogman.xml`

```xml
<AbilityDef>
    <defName>DMS_FrogmanRationRecovery</defName>
    <label>Metabolic Surge</label>
    <description>Feed one loaded C-Ration into the frogman's internal bioreactor. The chassis burns the entire packet at once, recharging its cells to full and sealing every wound on the parts it still has.\n\nDestroyed parts cannot be regrown this way.</description>
    <iconPath>UI/Ability/FieldRepair</iconPath>
    <cooldownTicksRange>15000</cooldownTicksRange>   
    <showPsycastEffects>false</showPsycastEffects>
    <sendMessageOnCooldownComplete>true</sendMessageOnCooldownComplete>
    <aiCanUse>true</aiCanUse>
    <targetRequired>false</targetRequired>
    <displayGizmoWhileUndrafted>true</displayGizmoWhileUndrafted>
    <disableGizmoWhileUndrafted>false</disableGizmoWhileUndrafted>
    <verbProperties>
      <verbClass>Verb_CastAbility</verbClass>
      <label>trigger metabolic surge</label>
      <drawAimPie>false</drawAimPie>
      <warmupTime>2</warmupTime>
      <violent>false</violent>
      <targetable>false</targetable>
      <requireLineOfSight>false</requireLineOfSight>
      <nonInterruptingSelfCast>true</nonInterruptingSelfCast>
      <targetParams>
        <canTargetSelf>true</canTargetSelf>
      </targetParams>
    </verbProperties>
    <comps>
      <li Class="DMS.CompProperties_AbilityRationRecovery">
        <rationCost>1</rationCost>
        <refillEnergy>true</refillEnergy>
        <healInjuries>true</healInjuries>
        <healPermanentInjuries>true</healPermanentInjuries>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </AbilityDef>

  
  
```

### AbilityDef:DMS_GravekeeperStugna — Stugna missile

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Things_Race/Races_Automatroid_Gravekeeper.xml`

```xml
<AbilityDef>
    <defName>DMS_GravekeeperStugna</defName>
    <label>Stugna missile</label>
    <description>Fire one of the two Stugna anti-tank guided missiles racked on the shoulder launcher. The shaped charge punches through heavy armor, but locking on takes time and needs a clear line of sight. Each missile is replaced a day after it is fired.</description>
    <iconPath>UI/Ability/Missile</iconPath>
    <aiCanUse>true</aiCanUse>
    <cooldownTicksRange>60000</cooldownTicksRange>
    <charges>2</charges>
    <cooldownPerCharge>true</cooldownPerCharge>
    <verbProperties>
      <verbClass>Verb_CastAbility</verbClass>
      <minRange>6.9</minRange>
      <range>44.9</range>
      <warmupTime>3</warmupTime>
      <ai_AvoidFriendlyFireRadius>4</ai_AvoidFriendlyFireRadius>
      <ai_ProjectileLaunchingIgnoresMeleeThreats>true</ai_ProjectileLaunchingIgnoresMeleeThreats>
      <ai_IsBuildingDestroyer>true</ai_IsBuildingDestroyer>
      <ai_TargetHasRangedAttackScoreOffset>50</ai_TargetHasRangedAttackScoreOffset>
      <soundCast>RocketswarmLauncher_Fire</soundCast>
      <targetParams>
        <canTargetPawns>true</canTargetPawns>
        <canTargetLocations>true</canTargetLocations>
        <canTargetBuildings>true</canTargetBuildings>
      </targetParams>
      <requireLineOfSight>true</requireLineOfSight>
    </verbProperties>
    <comps>
      <li Class="CompProperties_AbilityLaunchProjectile">
        <projectileDef>DMS_Bullet_GravekeeperStugna</projectileDef>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </AbilityDef>

  
```

### AbilityDef:DMS_Mothball — field mothball

來源：`1.7/Defs/Abilities/Common.xml`

```xml
<AbilityDef>
		<defName>DMS_Mothball</defName>
		<label>field mothball</label>
		<description>Disable system activity on the spot. The unit becomes a dormant storage structure that costs no bandwidth and takes no upkeep, and can be brought back online later by a mechanitor.\n\nStandard practice for garrison units between deployments.</description>
		<iconPath>UI/Ability/Mothball</iconPath>
		<cooldownTicksRange>2500</cooldownTicksRange>
		<showPsycastEffects>false</showPsycastEffects>
		<showGizmoOnWorldView>false</showGizmoOnWorldView>
		<aiCanUse>false</aiCanUse>
		<targetRequired>false</targetRequired>
		<verbProperties>
			<verbClass>Verb_CastAbility</verbClass>
			<label>fold into transport frame</label>
			<drawAimPie>false</drawAimPie>
			<warmupTime>3</warmupTime>
			<violent>false</violent>
			<targetable>false</targetable>
			<requireLineOfSight>false</requireLineOfSight>
			<targetParams>
				<canTargetSelf>true</canTargetSelf>
			</targetParams>
		</verbProperties>
		<comps>
			<li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_AbilityDeactivateToCapsule">
				<playerOnly>true</playerOnly>
				<allowWhileDrafted>true</allowWhileDrafted>
				<allowWhileDowned>false</allowWhileDowned>
				<sendMessage>true</sendMessage>
			</li>
		</comps>
	</AbilityDef>

	
	
```

### AbilityDef:DMS_SubsonicBurst — infrasonic burst

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Things_Item/DMS_Item_Subsonic.xml`

```xml
<AbilityDef ParentName="DMS_AddHediffSelfBase">
    <defName>DMS_SubsonicBurst</defName>
    <label>infrasonic burst</label>
    <description>Release a burst of tuned infrasound around this mech. Hostile living creatures in range suffer infrasonic trauma and may panic and flee. Mechs and allies are unaffected.</description>
    <iconPath>UI/Ability/Infrasound</iconPath>
    <aiCanUse>true</aiCanUse>
    <cooldownTicksRange>2500</cooldownTicksRange>
    <comps>
      <li Class="DMS.CompProperties_AbilitySubsonicPulse">
        <pulse>
          <radius>7.9</radius>
          <hediff>DMS_SubsonicTrauma</hediff>
          <severity>0.35</severity>
          <panicChance>0.4</panicChance>
          <earDamageDef>DMS_InfrasoundRupture</earDamageDef>
          <earDamage>3</earDamage>
          <hostileOnly>true</hostileOnly>
          <ignoreWalls>true</ignoreWalls>
          <fleck>PsycastAreaEffect</fleck>
          <sound>Explosion_EMP</sound>
        </pulse>
        <aiMinTargets>2</aiMinTargets>
      </li>
    </comps>
    <verbProperties>
      <range>7.9</range>
    </verbProperties>
  </AbilityDef>

  
  
  
  
```

### Fortified.FFF_InfoDef:DMS_Info_BionicShock — xeno limb syndrome

來源：`1.7/Defs/InfoDefs/DMS_InfoDefs_Bionic.xml`

```xml
<Fortified.FFF_InfoDef>
    <defName>DMS_Info_BionicShock</defName>
    <label>xeno limb syndrome</label>
    <description>Neurally interfaced prostheses have no biological receptors, so the nervous system never fully accepts them. Every installed prosthesis periodically triggers xeno limb syndrome: the first episode starts at LV.1, and each later episode pushes the existing syndrome up one level. The more prostheses a patient carries, the faster it worsens.\n\nThe syndrome has five levels, progressing from itching and pain through mental breaks to coma. Worsening beyond LV.5 is fatal.\n\nTreatment: each dose of neuroglue lowers the syndrome by one level, curing it outright at LV.1. While neuroglue is in effect, the syndrome cannot worsen.</description>
    <displayPriority>900</displayPriority>
    <hyperlinks>
      <HediffDef>DMS_BionicShock</HediffDef>
      <ThingDef>Neuroglue</ThingDef>
      <HediffDef>NeuroglueHigh</HediffDef>
    </hyperlinks>
  </Fortified.FFF_InfoDef>

  
  
```

### Fortified.FFF_InfoDef:DMS_Info_Neuroglue — neuroglue therapy

來源：`1.7/Defs/InfoDefs/DMS_InfoDefs_Bionic.xml`

```xml
<Fortified.FFF_InfoDef>
    <defName>DMS_Info_Neuroglue</defName>
    <label>neuroglue therapy</label>
    <description>Each dose takes effect immediately:\n - xeno limb syndrome is lowered by one level, or cured outright at LV.1.\n\nWhile neuroglue is in effect (about 5.5 days):\n - xeno limb syndrome cannot worsen;\n - synthetic rejection and phantom limb syndrome are cured, and clear up immediately if they recur;\n - the patient cannot contract fibrous or sensory mechanites.\n\nSide effect: mild pain for the duration.</description>
    <displayPriority>900</displayPriority>
    <hyperlinks>
      <HediffDef>NeuroglueHigh</HediffDef>
      <HediffDef>DMS_BionicShock</HediffDef>
      <HediffDef>DMS_SyntheticRejection</HediffDef>
      <HediffDef>DMS_BionicShockRemove</HediffDef>
      <HediffDef>FibrousMechanites</HediffDef>
      <HediffDef>SensoryMechanites</HediffDef>
    </hyperlinks>
  </Fortified.FFF_InfoDef>


```

### Fortified.FFF_InfoDef:DMS_Info_SyntheticRejection — synthetic rejection

來源：`1.7/Defs/InfoDefs/DMS_InfoDefs_Bionic.xml`

```xml
<Fortified.FFF_InfoDef>
    <defName>DMS_Info_SyntheticRejection</defName>
    <label>synthetic rejection</label>
    <description>The host's immune system never fully accepts biosynthetic tissue. Each installed biosynthetic part independently triggers synthetic rejection, on average once every 40 days.\n\nAn episode lasts 5 days, bringing fever and pain, slightly dulled consciousness and severely impaired blood filtration.\n\nTreatment: a single dose of neuroglue cures it at once, and any episode that begins while neuroglue is in effect clears up immediately.</description>
    <displayPriority>900</displayPriority>
    <hyperlinks>
      <HediffDef>DMS_SyntheticRejection</HediffDef>
      <ThingDef>Neuroglue</ThingDef>
      <HediffDef>NeuroglueHigh</HediffDef>
    </hyperlinks>
  </Fortified.FFF_InfoDef>

  
  
```

### GeneDef:DMS_Gene_FrogmanGestation — frogman gestation

來源：`1.7/Biotech/Defs/DMS_Frogman_Gestation.xml`

```xml
<GeneDef>
    <defName>DMS_Gene_FrogmanGestation</defName>
    <label>frogman gestation</label>
    <labelShortAdj>frogman</labelShortAdj>
    <description>The directed development sequence of an XM132 artificial military organism. Written into an embryo, it overrides normal gestation entirely: the mesonuclear substrate lays down a sealed synthetic-mechanical frame in place of human tissue, and drives itself toward one fixed adult form without any external guidance.\n\nA carrier brought to term produces a biomatroid larva rather than a child. The larva forms a gestation pod around itself and finishes developing outside the womb.\n\nThe sequence is inert in any other context. It cannot be inherited or expressed in a living body.\n\nColonial fleet law lists AMO development sequences as prohibited articles. Manufacture, transfer and use carry the same sentence, and fleets destroy production chains found on settled worlds rather than seize them.</description>
    <iconPath>UI/Gene/Gene_Wetware</iconPath>
    <displayOrderInCategory>81</displayOrderInCategory>
    <biostatMet>-18</biostatMet>
    
    <canGenerateInGeneSet>false</canGenerateInGeneSet>
    <biostatCpx>3</biostatCpx>
    <modExtensions>
      <li Class="DMS.MechBirthExtension">
        <productDef>DMS_SynthFormingPod</productDef>
        <failureThingDef>Artifuscle</failureThingDef>
        <failureThingCount>10~15</failureThingCount>
        <filthDef>Filth_AmnioticFluid</filthDef>
        <filthCount>5~10</filthCount>
        <exhaustBirther>true</exhaustBirther>
        <taleOnSuccess>DMS_Tale_MechGestated</taleOnSuccess>
        <taleOnFailure>DMS_Tale_MechGestationFailed</taleOnFailure>
        <historyEventOnSuccess>DMS_GestatedMech</historyEventOnSuccess>
        <letterLabel>Larva delivered</letterLabel>
        <letterText>Gestation of {PAWN_labelShort} is complete. The embryo produced a biomatroid larva, which has formed a gestation pod around itself.\n\nThe pod needs no power or maintenance and will finish developing on its own in a few days. It cannot defend itself, and can be uninstalled and moved to a safer place.</letterText>
        <failLetterLabel>Gestation failed</failLetterLabel>
        <failLetterText>The biomatroid carried by {PAWN_labelShort} failed to seal during final development. Only unusable tissue remains.</failLetterText>
      </li>
      
      <li Class="Fortified.ModExtension_VatEmbryoGraphic">
        <earlyStage>
          <texPath>Things/Resource/Wetware/Embryo</texPath>
          <graphicClass>Graphic_Single</graphicClass>
        </earlyStage>
        <lateStage>
          <texPath>Things/Synthroid/SynthForming</texPath>
          <graphicClass>Graphic_Single</graphicClass>
        </lateStage>
      </li>
    </modExtensions>
  </GeneDef>

  
  
```

```xml
<HediffDef>
    <defName>DMS_BF_RecoillessRifle</defName>
    <hediffClass>HediffWithComps</hediffClass>
    <label>Recoilless Rifle Rack</label>
    <description>A pair of 65mm recoilless tubes mounted on the side pylons and tied into the frame's fire control chain, reloaded from the frame's carried stores between engagements.\n\nThe shaped-charge warhead punches through armor and fortification that the frame's own weapon cannot touch, though the jet goes into a single narrow channel and anything standing beside the point of impact walks away. The mass hanging on the pylons costs the frame walking pace, dodging room and cargo allowance.</description>
    <descriptionHyperlinks>
      <ThingDef>DMS_BF_RecoillessRifle</ThingDef>
      <AbilityDef>DMS_BF_RecoillessShot</AbilityDef>
      <ThingDef>DMS_Mech_BattleFrame</ThingDef>
      <ThingDef>DMS_Mech_EscortLifter</ThingDef>
      <ThingDef>DMS_Mech_FieldCommand</ThingDef>
      <ThingDef>DMS_Mech_Iguana</ThingDef>

          <Mass>10</Mass>

          </dataNorth>

<HediffDef>
    <defName>DMS_Hediff_ERAPlating</defName>
    <label>electromagnetic reactive plating</label>
    <description>An add-on array of electromagnetic reactive armor bricks bolted over the chassis. When a shaped charge jet or a heavy explosive hit lands, the brick above it detonates outward and defeats the penetrator entirely, at the cost of being consumed and shocking the frame underneath.\n\nIt does nothing against small arms or melee; those are the job of the base plating. Spent bricks must be replenished with steel.</description>
    <hediffClass>HediffWithComps</hediffClass>
    <isBad>false</isBad>
    <scenarioCanAdd>false</scenarioCanAdd>
    <everCurableByItem>false</everCurableByItem>
    <maxSeverity>1</maxSeverity>
    <initialSeverity>1</initialSeverity>
    <comps>
      <li Class="Fortified.HediffCompProperties_DamageBlocker">
        
        <damageThreshold>18</damageThreshold>
        <thresholdInclusive>true</thresholdInclusive>
        
        <preApplyDamagePriority>20</preApplyDamagePriority>
        <blockCharges>4</blockCharges>

        
        <allowedDamageDefs>
          <li>Bomb</li>
          <li MayRequire="ceteam.combatextended">Bomb_Secondary</li>
        </allowedDamageDefs>
        <allowRanged>true</allowRanged>
        <allowMelee>false</allowMelee>
        <allowDirect>true</allowDirect>

        
        <consumeChargeAbove>true</consumeChargeAbove>
        <blockAboveThreshold>true</blockAboveThreshold>
        <clampAboveToThreshold>false</clampAboveToThreshold>

        
        <consumeChargeBelow>false</consumeChargeBelow>
        <blockBelowThreshold>false</blockBelowThreshold>

        <aboveThresholdEffecter>Deflect_Metal_Bullet</aboveThresholdEffecter>
        <eraEffecter>Deflect_Metal_Bullet</eraEffecter>
        <showGizmo>true</showGizmo>

        
        <eraOnConsumeCharge>true</eraOnConsumeCharge>
        <eraEntries>
          <li>
            <damageDef>Blunt</damageDef>
            <damageAmount>6</damageAmount>
          </li>
        </eraEntries>

        
        <repairMaterial>Steel</repairMaterial>
        <chargesPerMaterial>1</chargesPerMaterial>
        <requiredReplenishWorkType>Crafting</requiredReplenishWorkType>
        <autoRecharge>false</autoRecharge>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </HediffDef>

### HediffDef:DMS_RealitySuppressed — reality suppressed

```xml
<HediffDef>
    <defName>DMS_RealitySuppressed</defName>
    <label>reality suppressed</label>
    <description>A reality anchor's field is pinning this creature to ordinary physics. The transcendent properties that sustain it are being stripped away: it moves and acts sluggishly, strikes with half its strength and is far easier to hold in containment.\n\nThe effect lifts within moments of leaving the field.</description>

      </li>
    </comps>

      <li>
        <capMods>
          <li><capacity>Consciousness</capacity><setMax>0.8</setMax></li>
          <li><capacity>Moving</capacity><setMax>0.6</setMax></li>
          <li><capacity>Manipulation</capacity><setMax>0.6</setMax></li>
        </capMods>
        <statFactors>
          <MeleeDamageFactor>0.5</MeleeDamageFactor>
        </statFactors>
      </li>
    </stages>
    <modExtensions>
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_HediffStatRules">
        <rules>
          
          <li><stat>MinimumContainmentStrength</stat><factor>0.5</factor></li>
        </rules>
      </li>
    </modExtensions>
  </HediffDef>

### HediffDef:DMS_SubsonicTrauma — infrasonic trauma

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Things_Item/DMS_Item_Subsonic.xml`

```xml
<HediffDef>
    <defName>DMS_SubsonicTrauma</defName>
    <label>infrasonic trauma</label>
    <description>Tuned infrasound has set this creature's inner ear and viscera resonating. It causes nausea, disorientation and deep, diffuse pain that no wound explains. The keener a creature's hearing, the harder it is hit; a deaf creature is unaffected. Repeated exposure stacks up quickly, and at its worst the pain alone is enough to cause shock.\n\nThe effect fades on its own within a couple of hours.</description>
    <hediffClass>HediffWithComps</hediffClass>
    <defaultLabelColor>(0.8, 0.8, 0.35)</defaultLabelColor>
    <isBad>true</isBad>
    <makesSickThought>true</makesSickThought>
    <initialSeverity>0.01</initialSeverity>
    <maxSeverity>1</maxSeverity>
    <comps>
      <li Class="HediffCompProperties_SeverityPerDay">
        <severityPerDay>-12</severityPerDay>
      </li>
    </comps>
    <stages>
      <li>
        <label>discomfort</label>
        <painOffset>0.1</painOffset>
        <capMods>
          <li>
            <capacity>Consciousness</capacity>
            <offset>-0.05</offset>
          </li>
          <li>
            <capacity>Hearing</capacity>
            <offset>-0.1</offset>
          </li>
        </capMods>
      </li>
      <li>
        <minSeverity>0.3</minSeverity>
        <label>disoriented</label>
        <painOffset>0.25</painOffset>
        <vomitMtbDays>0.05</vomitMtbDays>
        <statOffsets>
          <ShootingAccuracyPawn>-0.3</ShootingAccuracyPawn>
        </statOffsets>
        <capMods>
          <li>
            <capacity>Consciousness</capacity>
            <offset>-0.15</offset>
          </li>
          <li>
            <capacity>Manipulation</capacity>
            <offset>-0.2</offset>
          </li>
          <li>
            <capacity>Moving</capacity>
            <offset>-0.2</offset>
          </li>
          <li>
            <capacity>Hearing</capacity>
            <offset>-0.3</offset>
          </li>
        </capMods>
      </li>
      <li>
        <minSeverity>0.7</minSeverity>
        <label>agonizing</label>
        <painOffset>0.5</painOffset>
        <vomitMtbDays>0.02</vomitMtbDays>
        <statOffsets>
          <ShootingAccuracyPawn>-0.5</ShootingAccuracyPawn>
        </statOffsets>
        <capMods>
          <li>
            <capacity>Consciousness</capacity>
            <offset>-0.3</offset>
          </li>
          <li>
            <capacity>Manipulation</capacity>
            <offset>-0.4</offset>
          </li>
          <li>
            <capacity>Moving</capacity>
            <offset>-0.4</offset>
          </li>
          <li>
            <capacity>Hearing</capacity>
            <offset>-0.6</offset>
          </li>
        </capMods>
      </li>

### LayoutRoomDef:DMS_ArchiveCorridor — 

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Vault/DMS_Archive.xml`

```xml
<LayoutRoomDef>
    <defName>DMS_ArchiveCorridor</defName>
    <roomContentsWorkerType>DMS.RoomContents_VaultMainHall</roomContentsWorkerType>
    <dontDestroyWallsDoors>true</dontDestroyWallsDoors>
    <isValidPlayerSpawnRoom>false</isValidPlayerSpawnRoom>
    <prefabs>
      <DMS_Prefab_VentBank>
        <countPerTenEdgeCells>0.3</countPerTenEdgeCells>
        <minMaxRange>0~2</minMaxRange>
      </DMS_Prefab_VentBank>
      <DMS_Prefab_DataRackRow_Edge>
        <countPerTenEdgeCells>0.3</countPerTenEdgeCells>
        <minMaxRange>0~2</minMaxRange>
      </DMS_Prefab_DataRackRow_Edge>
    </prefabs>
    <modExtensions>
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_VaultSecurity">
        <corridorExpansion>3</corridorExpansion>
        <stripTerrain>Concrete</stripTerrain>

        
        <conduitDef>HiddenConduit</conduitDef>
        <conduitAlongWalls>true</conduitAlongWalls>
        <substationDef>DMS_SubstationCabinet_Wall</substationDef>
        
        <wallSubstation>false</wallSubstation>

        <barricadeDef>Barricade</barricadeDef>
        <barricadeStuff>Steel</barricadeStuff>
        <turretDef>DMS_Turret_Sentry</turretDef>
        <wreckedTurretDef>DMS_Wreckage_SentryGun</wreckedTurretDef>
        
        <turretWreckChance>0.2</turretWreckChance>
        
        <checkpointTurrets>false</checkpointTurrets>
        <cornerTurretChance>0.35</cornerTurretChance>
        <maxCornerTurretsPerRect>1</maxCornerTurretsPerRect>
        <sensorDef>DMS_Building_Sensor</sensorDef>
        <nestDef>DMS_Building_FPVNest</nestDef>
        <nestChance>0.7</nestChance>
        <gasVentDef>DMS_Building_GasVent</gasVentDef>
        <gasVentChance>0.5</gasVentChance>
        
        <subsonicEmitterDef>DMS_Building_SubsonicEmitter_Security</subsonicEmitterDef>
        <subsonicEmitterChance>0.25</subsonicEmitterChance>
        <checkpointSpacing>16</checkpointSpacing>
        <maxCheckpointsPerRect>2</maxCheckpointsPerRect>

        <cameraDef>DMS_Building_Camera</cameraDef>
        <initialBatteryPct>1</initialBatteryPct>
      </li>
    </modExtensions>
  </LayoutRoomDef>

  
  
```

### QuestScriptDef:DMS_AirportAssault — 

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Quests/DMS_LegacySite_Airport.xml`

```xml
<QuestScriptDef>
    <defName>DMS_AirportAssault</defName>
    <successHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestSuccess_Military</successHistoryEvent>
    <failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestFailed_Military</failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>
    
    <rootSelectionWeight>0.4</rootSelectionWeight>
    <rootMinPoints>1200</rootMinPoints>
    <expireDaysRange>4~8</expireDaysRange>
    <sendAvailableLetter>true</sendAvailableLetter>
    <questNameRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        <li>questName-&gt;Silent airfield</li>
        <li>questName-&gt;The [field]</li>
        <li>field-&gt;Remnant airfield</li>
        <li>field-&gt;Drone field</li>
        <li>field-&gt;Weaver's roost</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questNameRules>
    <questDescriptionRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        <li>questDescription-&gt;Intercepted telemetry points to a [siteFactionName] drone airfield. The field is still active: a garrison of (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat) patrols the tower and the aprons, and the tower's decoy radio is still tuned to the command band of the cluster weaver.\n\nThat radio is the prize. Clear the field and it can be used to call the weaver down onto the airfield, on ground of your choosing, far from your colony. Whatever the mothership drops when it falls is yours to strip.\n\nBeneath the aprons there is also a freight elevator into a buried storage vault. Its blast doors answer to two security consoles in the tower; hack both to open the shaft.\n\nThe telemetry fix holds for [siteTimeout]. After that the field goes dark and its position is lost.\n\nThe installation also runs a site server: a small records host that can be hacked once for blueprints or access keys, at the cost of setting off the alarm.\n\nCaution: it is a hostile installation. Once you enter, its monitoring protocol will summon enemy reinforcements after a countdown, and the weaver will not wait for you to finish with them.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questDescriptionRules>
    <root Class="Fortified.QuestNode_Root_FFF_TimedHostileSite">
      <factionDef>DMS_Legacy</factionDef>
      <sitePartDef>DMS_AirportSite</sitePartDef>
      <baseTimeoutDays>16</baseTimeoutDays>
      <minTimeoutDays>4</minTimeoutDays>
      <maxTimeoutDays>30</maxTimeoutDays>
      <expiredLetterLabelKey>DMS_Airport_ExpiredLabel</expiredLetterLabelKey>
      <expiredLetterTextKey>DMS_Airport_ExpiredText</expiredLetterTextKey>
      <clearedLetterLabelKey>DMS_Airport_ClearedLabel</clearedLetterLabelKey>
      <clearedLetterTextKey>DMS_Airport_ClearedText</clearedLetterTextKey>
    </root>
  </QuestScriptDef>


```

### QuestScriptDef:DMS_CourtMartial — 

來源：`1.7/Defs/Quests/CourtMartial.xml`

```xml
<QuestScriptDef>
    <defName>DMS_CourtMartial</defName>
    <successHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestSuccess_Ceremony</successHistoryEvent>
    <failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestFailed_Ceremony</failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>
    <rootSelectionWeight>1</rootSelectionWeight>
    <rootMinPoints>0</rootMinPoints>
    <defaultChallengeRating>2</defaultChallengeRating>
    <expireDaysRange>6~10</expireDaysRange>
    <questNameRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        <li>questName-&gt;Court-martial: [defendant_nameFull]</li>
        <li>questName-&gt;Military tribunal summons</li>
        <li>questName-&gt;Fleet judicial notice</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questNameRules>
    <questDescriptionRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        
        
        <li>questDescription(defendantRanked==True)-&gt;A sergeant of the military police command of [issuerFactionName], [asker_nameFull], has issued a notice over the public band, expressing [asker_possessive] strictly-official concern over the recent military-diplomatic incident caused by [playerFactionName]. As [playerFactionName] counts enlisted personnel of [issuerFactionName] among its members, [asker_pronoun] intends to settle the matter through formal court-martial proceedings.\n\nBy [asker_possessive] account, the highest-ranking officer of [playerFactionName], [defendant_nameFull], must report to the fleet's local military tribunal for investigation and questioning. Should [playerFactionName] cooperate, [asker_pronoun] will immediately requisition an orbital transport to collect [defendant_nameDef], and hostilities between [issuerFactionName] and [playerFactionName] will be suspended for the duration.\n\n[asker_nameDef] tells us the investigation will conclude within [investigationDays] days, after which the accused will answer for the charges in court, the verdict to be pronounced by the [issuerFactionName] Navigation Hall and executed at once. If [defendant_nameDef] cooperates, [defendant_possessive] punishment will be weighed leniently, though given the gravity of a military incident, it will still mean short-term detention and a demotion at the very least.\n\nRoom, board and medical care during [defendant_possessive] sentence will be borne by [issuerFactionName], and [defendant_pronoun] will be returned to [playerFactionName] once it is served.</li>

        <li>questDescription(defendantRanked==True)-&gt;Over the public band, [asker_nameFull], a duty sergeant of the [issuerFactionName] military police command, has served us formal notice: the recent military-diplomatic incident attributed to [playerFactionName] will not be ignored. Because members of [playerFactionName] remain on the [issuerFactionName] service roll, [asker_pronoun] insists the affair be resolved before a proper court-martial rather than on a battlefield.\n\nThe terms are plain. Our highest-ranking officer, [defendant_nameFull], is to submit to investigation and questioning at the fleet's local tribunal. Upon our agreement, [asker_pronoun] will requisition an orbital transport for [defendant_nameDef] without delay, and [issuerFactionName] will hold its guns for as long as the proceedings run.\n\nPer [asker_nameDef], the inquiry closes within [investigationDays] days; the accused will then speak in [defendant_possessive] own defense before the bench, and the Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] will pass sentence for immediate execution. Cooperation buys leniency, but a military incident of this weight carries no less than brief detention and one grade of demotion.\n\nThe fleet will feed, house and treat [defendant_nameDef] throughout the sentence, and return [defendant_pronoun] to [playerFactionName] when it ends.</li>

        <li>questDescription(defendantRanked==True)-&gt;[asker_nameFull], sergeant of the military police command, [issuerFactionName], has broadcast an official communiqué regarding the military-diplomatic incident recently caused by [playerFactionName]. [asker_pronoun] frames it as nothing personal, merely procedure: since [playerFactionName] harbors personnel still enrolled with [issuerFactionName], the matter falls under military jurisdiction and must go before a court-martial.\n\n[asker_pronoun] requires that [defendant_nameFull], the senior rank-holder of [playerFactionName], attend the fleet's local tribunal for investigation and questioning. The moment we consent, an orbital transport will be requisitioned to carry [defendant_nameDef] up, and [issuerFactionName] will suspend all hostilities against [playerFactionName] pending judgment.\n\nAs [asker_nameDef] lays it out: [investigationDays] days of investigation, then the accused argues [defendant_possessive] defense in open court, and the [issuerFactionName] Navigation Hall pronounces sentence on the spot. Willing cooperation will be weighed in mitigation, but the minimum remains short-term detention plus demotion by one grade.\n\nQuarters, rations and medical care during the sentence come at [issuerFactionName]'s expense; [defendant_pronoun] will be shipped back to [playerFactionName] on release.</li>

        
        <li>questDescription(defendantRanked==False)-&gt;A sergeant of the military police command of [issuerFactionName], [asker_nameFull], has issued a notice over the public band, expressing [asker_possessive] strictly-official concern over the recent military-diplomatic incident caused by [playerFactionName]. No member of [playerFactionName] holds a commission [asker_pronoun] could act against, so [asker_pronoun] intends to proceed against the settlement itself, through formal court-martial proceedings.\n\nBy [asker_possessive] account, [playerFactionName] must surrender the member it can least afford to lose, [defendant_nameFull], to the fleet's local military tribunal for investigation and questioning. Should [playerFactionName] cooperate, [asker_pronoun] will immediately requisition an orbital transport to collect [defendant_nameDef], and hostilities between [issuerFactionName] and [playerFactionName] will be suspended for the duration.\n\n[asker_nameDef] tells us the investigation will conclude within [investigationDays] days, after which the accused will answer for the charges in court, the verdict to be pronounced by the [issuerFactionName] Navigation Hall and executed at once. There is no rank here to reduce, so nothing can be taken off in mitigation: the sentence is detention, and the whole of it.\n\nRoom, board and medical care during [defendant_possessive] sentence will be borne by [issuerFactionName], and [defendant_pronoun] will be returned to [playerFactionName] once it is served.</li>
        <li>questDescription(defendantRanked==False)-&gt;Over the public band, [asker_nameFull], a duty sergeant of the [issuerFactionName] military police command, has served us formal notice: the recent military-diplomatic incident attributed to [playerFactionName] will not be ignored. Nobody among us carries a commission [asker_pronoun] could try, so [asker_pronoun] is trying the settlement instead, before a proper court-martial rather than on a battlefield.\n\nThe terms are plain. [playerFactionName] is to hand over whoever it values most, and by the fleet's reckoning that is [defendant_nameFull]. Upon our agreement, [asker_pronoun] will requisition an orbital transport for [defendant_nameDef] without delay, and [issuerFactionName] will hold its guns for as long as the proceedings run.\n\nPer [asker_nameDef], the inquiry closes within [investigationDays] days; the accused will then speak in [defendant_possessive] own defense before the bench, and the Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] will pass sentence for immediate execution. With no grade to strip, leniency has nothing to work with: the sentence is detention, and the full term of it.\n\nThe fleet will feed, house and treat [defendant_nameDef] throughout the sentence, and return [defendant_pronoun] to [playerFactionName] when it ends.</li>
        <li>questDescription(defendantRanked==False)-&gt;[asker_nameFull], sergeant of the military police command, [issuerFactionName], has broadcast an official communiqué regarding the military-diplomatic incident recently caused by [playerFactionName]. [asker_pronoun] frames it as nothing personal, merely procedure: with no commissioned personnel among us to answer for it, jurisdiction falls on [playerFactionName] as a body, and the matter must still go before a court-martial.\n\n[asker_pronoun] requires that [playerFactionName] give up its most valuable member, named in the communiqué as [defendant_nameFull], to attend the fleet's local tribunal for investigation and questioning. The moment we consent, an orbital transport will be requisitioned to carry [defendant_nameDef] up, and [issuerFactionName] will suspend all hostilities against [playerFactionName] pending judgment.\n\nAs [asker_nameDef] lays it out: [investigationDays] days of investigation, then the accused argues [defendant_possessive] defense in open court, and the [issuerFactionName] Navigation Hall pronounces sentence on the spot. A demotion is the usual mitigation and there is none available here, so what remains is detention, served out to the day.\n\nQuarters, rations and medical care during the sentence come at [issuerFactionName]'s expense; [defendant_pronoun] will be shipped back to [playerFactionName] on release.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questDescriptionRules>

        <li>questName-&gt;Remnant relay station</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questNameRules>

      <rulesStrings>
        <li>questDescription-&gt;While broadcasting the falsified peacekeeping distress call, the beacon triangulated the source relaying it: a [siteFactionName] signal-relay station.\n\nThe station is guarded by (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat). Its transmitter array is still intact: a decoy antenna on site can be rigged to lure a high-value automatroid unit.\n\nThe relay's transmission window closes in [siteTimeout]. After that, the station will relocate and its position will be lost.\n\nCaution: it is a hostile installation. Once you enter, its monitoring protocol will summon enemy reinforcements after a countdown; strike fast and leave faster.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questDescriptionRules>

<QuestScriptDef>
    <defName>DMS_FleetNetworkSite</defName>
    <successHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestSuccess_Military</successHistoryEvent>
    <failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestFailed_Military</failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>

        <li>questName(installation==DMS_SageNodeSite)-&gt;SAGE</li>
        <li>questName(installation==DMS_SageNodeSite)-&gt;Blind the [sage]</li>

        <li>sage-&gt;strategic host</li>
        <li>sage-&gt;air-defense host</li>
      </rulesStrings>

    <questDescriptionRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        <li>questDescription(installation==DMS_SageNodeSite)-&gt;We have found the host that is coordinating [fleetName]'s hunt for us: a SAGE node, the distributed strategic command computer the fleet uses for planetary air defense and to tie together the radar and navigation networks across several continents. Its rack array is guarded by (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat), and it is wired into a full facility alarm system with fire support.\n\nThe SAGE core can be hacked two or three times. Each run pulls technical blueprints, sealed data caches or access keys out of its strategic database, and each run will set off the facility's alarm again. Destroying it will cripple the fleet's hunt; within a year or two another computer on the SAGE network will be promoted to host and pick up where it left off.\n\nThe node's coordinates hold for [siteTimeout], until the network rotates its hosts.\n\nCaution: it is a hostile installation. Once you enter, its monitoring protocol will summon enemy reinforcements after a countdown, and the node can call in mortar fire.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questDescriptionRules>

    <rootSelectionWeight>1.0</rootSelectionWeight>

    <sendAvailableLetter>true</sendAvailableLetter>

        <li>questName(installation==DMS_VaultStationSite)-&gt;The [vault]</li>

        <li>depot-&gt;Repair depot</li>
        <li>depot-&gt;Maintenance yard</li>
        <li>depot-&gt;Cradle yard</li>
        
        <li>questName(installation==DMS_OperationBaseSite)-&gt;Forward base</li>
        <li>questName(installation==DMS_OperationBaseSite)-&gt;The [base]</li>
        <li>base-&gt;Remnant FOB</li>
        <li>base-&gt;Wire perimeter</li>
        <li>base-&gt;Supply dump</li>
        
        <li>questName(installation==DMS_SiteStationSite)-&gt;Derelict station</li>
        <li>questName(installation==DMS_SiteStationSite)-&gt;The [station]</li>
        <li>station-&gt;Dead station</li>
        <li>station-&gt;Old station</li>
        <li>station-&gt;Rusted station</li>
        
        <li>questName(installation==DMS_LaunchSiteSite)-&gt;Launch site salvage</li>
        <li>questName(installation==DMS_LaunchSiteSite)-&gt;The [site]</li>
        <li>site-&gt;Dead launch site</li>
        <li>site-&gt;Silo field</li>
        <li>site-&gt;Wrecked pad</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questNameRules>
    <questDescriptionRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        
        <li>questDescription(installation==DMS_VaultStationSite)-&gt;A supply manifest recovered from remnant traffic lists a [siteFactionName] storage vault, and the surface station that sits on top of it. The station is still manned by (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat), and heavy units are among them.\n\nThe freight elevator into the vault is locked under an armored cover plate, slaved to the access console beside it. The console takes a key-card, not a hack: swipe one and the plate retracts. The car still has power, so what is below was never collected.\n\nThe manifest's location fix expires in [siteTimeout]. After that the station will relocate and its position will be lost.\n\nThe installation also runs a site server: a small records host that can be hacked once for blueprints or access keys, at the cost of setting off the alarm.\n\nCaution: it is a hostile installation. Once you enter, its monitoring protocol will summon enemy reinforcements after a countdown. Get the shaft open, then decide whether to hold the surface or go down.</li>

        
        <li>questDescription(installation==DMS_RepairStationSite)-&gt;A maintenance request on the remnant network leads to a [siteFactionName] field repair depot. The depot is guarded by (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat): engineers, riflemen and a drone screen.\n\nTwo units are still clamped in the depot's cradles, in hibernation, behind a sealed maintenance door. They were never re-authenticated after servicing, so a mechanitor with spare bandwidth can hack one and take it. The depot's security console releases the door. There is also a mobile crew lifter on the pad and a stock of tungsteel in the stores.\n\nThe request's location fix expires in [siteTimeout]. After that the depot will relocate and its position will be lost.\n\nThe installation also runs a site server: a small records host that can be hacked once for blueprints or access keys, at the cost of setting off the alarm.\n\nCaution: it is a hostile installation. Once you enter, its monitoring protocol will summon enemy reinforcements after a countdown.</li>

        
        <li>questDescription(installation==DMS_OperationBaseSite)-&gt;Remnant traffic has given away a [siteFactionName] forward operating base. It is held by (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat): line infantry behind the wire, with heavy support and night-capable units in reserve.\n\nThe base is a supply hub. Crates of rations, small arms, spare parts and prosthetics sit in the open, and a freight elevator at the back of the compound leads down into a buried store. The blast doors in front of it answer to two security consoles; hack both to open the way, then hack the lift itself.\n\nThe position fix holds for [siteTimeout]. After that the base will strike camp and its position will be lost.\n\nThe installation also runs a site server: a small records host that can be hacked once for blueprints or access keys, at the cost of setting off the alarm.\n\nCaution: it is a hostile installation. Once you enter, its monitoring protocol will summon enemy reinforcements after a countdown.</li>

        
        <li>questDescription(installation==DMS_SiteStationSite)-&gt;A pre-war station, half of it collapsed, has been located nearby. A [siteFactionName] detachment has dug into the ruins: (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat), shield-bearers and infantry with drone and lifter support, spread across the station's halls.\n\nThe station was abandoned in a hurry. Ancient supply crates, industrial shelving and the wrecks of the old security systems are still scattered through it, along with a working pod launcher pair. Everything the detachment has not already stripped is yours.\n\nThe detachment is expected to move on in [siteTimeout]. After that the station will be picked clean and no longer worth the trip.\n\nThe installation also runs a site server: a small records host that can be hacked once for blueprints or access keys, at the cost of setting off the alarm.\n\nOne of the station's freight elevators still runs down to a data archive the fleet buried beneath it. A facility server core sits in the sealed server hall at the bottom; it can be hacked several times, and every attempt will bring the archive's defences up from below. The corridors are fitted with gas vents, and a lockdown controller will seal the lift a minute after the alert level maxes out.\n\nCaution: it is a hostile installation. Once you enter, its monitoring protocol will summon enemy reinforcements after a countdown, and the station is large enough to get lost in.</li>

        
        <li>questDescription(installation==DMS_LaunchSiteSite)-&gt;An old missile launch complex has turned up on the scanners. The launchers were destroyed long ago and the compound is falling apart, but a [siteFactionName] patrol of (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat) still sweeps the wreckage.\n\nNobody ever salvaged the place. Wrecked automatroids, a logistics container, sensor and radar mounts and the remains of the launch crews' equipment are all still where they fell.\n\nThe patrol's schedule puts it there for another [siteTimeout]. After that it moves on and the site's position is lost.\n\nThe installation also runs a site server: a small records host that can be hacked once for blueprints or access keys, at the cost of setting off the alarm.\n\nCaution: it is a hostile installation. Once you enter, the patrol's monitoring protocol will summon enemy reinforcements after a countdown.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questDescriptionRules>
    <root Class="DMS.QuestNode_Root_DMS_RandomInstallation">
      <factionDef>DMS_Legacy</factionDef>
      <baseTimeoutDays>16</baseTimeoutDays>
      <minTimeoutDays>4</minTimeoutDays>
      <maxTimeoutDays>30</maxTimeoutDays>
      
      <installations>

### QuestScriptDef:DMS_OfficerTraining — 

來源：`1.7/Royalty/Defs/Quests/OfficerTraining.xml`

```xml
<QuestScriptDef>
    <defName>DMS_OfficerTraining</defName>
    <successHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestSuccess_Ceremony</successHistoryEvent>
    <failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestFailed_Ceremony</failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>
    
    <rootSelectionWeight>0</rootSelectionWeight>
    <questNameRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        <li>questName-&gt;[trainee_nameFull]'s officer training</li>
        <li>questName-&gt;[newTitle] training requirement: [trainee_nameFull]</li>
        <li>questName-&gt;Fleet service education notice</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questNameRules>
    <questDescriptionRules>
      <rulesStrings>

        <li>questAskerReason-&gt;[asker_nameFull], a training instructor of [issuerFactionName], has passed a course notice on to the colony.</li>
        <li>questAskerReason-&gt;[asker_nameFull], the case officer handling this for [issuerFactionName], has sent formal notice over the fleet band.</li>
        <li>questAskerReason-&gt;The service education command of [issuerFactionName] has mailed a formal notice to [playerFactionName].</li>

        <li>questTrainee-&gt;[trainee_nameFull] has the service record for the rank of [newTitle], but fleet command requires officers of that grade to log enough course hours before the post can be formally conferred.</li>
        <li>questTrainee-&gt;[trainee_nameFull] is now carried on the Colonial Forces' promotion roll for [newTitle]. Regulations, however, forbid conferring that grade on anyone who has not sat a formal military training course.</li>
        <li>questTrainee-&gt;[asker_nameFull], the officer who signed the notice, points out that [trainee_nameFull]'s promotion to [newTitle] stays on hold until formal military training produces a certificate of qualification.</li>

        <li>questExplain-&gt;[asker_pronoun] will arrange an orbital transport to carry [trainee_nameDef] to the training establishment for a [trainingDays]-day [courseName], with board and medical care charged to the Colonial Forces.</li>
        <li>questExplain-&gt;The fleet will requisition an orbital transport to collect [trainee_nameDef] for [trainingDays] days of instruction at the training centre running the [courseName].</li>
        <li>questExplain-&gt;[trainee_nameDef] will train at the centre for [trainingDays] days, with board for the duration charged to the Colonial Forces.</li>

        <li>questEndExplain-&gt;On graduation [trainee_pronoun] will be granted the rank of [newTitle] at the centre and returned to us, having gained the relevant experience and, quite possibly, shed a bad habit along the way.</li>
        <li>questEndExplain-&gt;Once the course is complete [trainee_nameDef] will be commissioned and returned to [playerFactionName] intact.</li>

        <li>questWarning-&gt;Note that [trainee_nameDef] falls under [issuerFactionName] military discipline for the duration of the course. Should [playerFactionName] turn hostile, the trainee will be detained as the regulations provide.</li>

        <li>questDescription-&gt;[questAskerReason] [questTrainee]\n\n[questExplain] [questEndExplain]\n\n[questWarning]</li>
        <li>questDescription-&gt;[questAskerReason] [questTrainee]\n\n[questExplain] [questEndExplain]\n\n[questWarning]</li>
        <li>questDescription-&gt;[questAskerReason] [questTrainee]\n\n[questExplain] [questEndExplain]\n\n[questWarning]</li>

      </rulesStrings>
    </questDescriptionRules>
    <root Class="DMS.QuestNode_Root_OfficerTraining">
      <fleetFactionDef>DMS_Army</fleetFactionDef>
      <transportShipDef>DMS_Ship_TransportShuttle</transportShipDef>

### QuestScriptDef:DMS_PirateAssemblyRaid — 

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Quests/DMS_PirateAssemblyQuest.xml`

```xml
<QuestScriptDef>
    <defName>DMS_PirateAssemblyRaid</defName>
    <successHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestSuccess_Military</successHistoryEvent>
    <failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestFailed_Military</failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>
    
    <rootSelectionWeight>1.0</rootSelectionWeight>
    <rootMinPoints>500</rootMinPoints>
    <canGiveRoyalFavor>true</canGiveRoyalFavor>
    <expireDaysRange>4~8</expireDaysRange>
    <questNameRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        
        <li>questName(priority=1)-&gt;[asker_nameDef] and the [yard]</li>
        <li>questName(priority=1)-&gt;The [yard] Contract</li>
        <li>questName-&gt;[bandit] [yard]</li>
        <li>bandit-&gt;Pirate</li>
        <li>bandit-&gt;Raider</li>
        <li>bandit-&gt;Outlaw</li>
        <li>bandit-&gt;Marauder</li>
        <li>yard-&gt;Assembly Yard</li>
        <li>yard-&gt;Mech Works</li>
        <li>yard-&gt;Foundry</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questNameRules>
    <questDescriptionRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        
        <li>questDescription(askerIsNull==true)-&gt;We've intercepted messages about an old automatroid assembly yard not far from [map_definite]. A [siteFaction_name] crew has seized it and put the line back into service. The machines coming off it are being built for their own raids.\n\nThe yard is defended by (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat).\n\nWhatever is still on the assembly racks is ours for the taking. Units that have not been finished never had their command authentication locked, so a mechanitor with spare bandwidth can hack one and take control of it.\n\nEntering the yard will alert the crew, and enemy reinforcements will arrive some time later.</li>

        
        <li>questDescription(asker_factionLeader==True)-&gt;[asker_nameFull], [asker_faction_leaderTitle] of [asker_faction_name], has sent us a message. A [siteFaction_name] crew has seized an old automatroid assembly yard nearby and put the line back into service. Every machine it turns out is one more that will be hitting [asker_faction_name] caravans.\n\n[asker_nameDef] is asking us to shut the yard down, which means eliminating all enemies and turrets. It is defended by (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat).\n\nWhatever is still on the assembly racks is ours to keep. Units that have not been finished never had their command authentication locked, so a mechanitor with spare bandwidth can hack one and take control of it.\n\nEntering the yard will alert the crew, and enemy reinforcements will arrive some time later.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questDescriptionRules>
    <root Class="QuestNode_Sequence">
      <nodes>
        <li Class="QuestNode_SubScript">
          <def>Util_RandomizePointsChallengeRating</def>
          <parms>
            <pointsFactorTwoStar>1.5</pointsFactorTwoStar>
            <pointsFactorThreeStar>2</pointsFactorThreeStar>
          </parms>
        </li>

        <li Class="QuestNode_SubScript">
          <def>Util_AdjustPointsForDistantFight</def>
        </li>

        <li Class="QuestNode_GetMap">
          <canBeSpace>true</canBeSpace>
        </li>

        
        <li Class="QuestNode_IsSet">
          <name>asker</name>
          <elseNode Class="QuestNode_RandomNode">
            <nodes>
              <li Class="QuestNode_Set">
                <name>askerIsNull</name>
                <value>true</value>
                <selectionWeight>0.4</selectionWeight>
              </li>
              <li Class="QuestNode_GetPawn">
                <storeAs>asker</storeAs>
                <mustBeFactionLeader>true</mustBeFactionLeader>
                <mustBeNonHostileToPlayer>true</mustBeNonHostileToPlayer>
                <allowPermanentEnemyFaction>false</allowPermanentEnemyFaction>
                <selectionWeight>0.6</selectionWeight>
              </li>
            </nodes>
          </elseNode>
        </li>

        <li Class="QuestNode_GetSiteTile">
          <storeAs>siteTile</storeAs>
          <preferCloserTiles>true</preferCloserTiles>
        </li>

        
        <li Class="QuestNode_GetSitePartDefsByTagsAndFaction">
          <storeAs>sitePartDefs</storeAs>
          <storeFactionAs>siteFaction</storeFactionAs>
          <sitePartsTags>
            <li><tag>DMS_PirateAssembly</tag></li>
          </sitePartsTags>
        </li>

        <li Class="QuestNode_GetDefaultSitePartsParams">
          <tile>$siteTile</tile>
          <faction>$siteFaction</faction>
          <sitePartDefs>$sitePartDefs</sitePartDefs>
          <storeSitePartsParamsAs>sitePartsParams</storeSitePartsParamsAs>
        </li>

        
        <li Class="QuestNode_GetSiteThreatPoints">
          <storeAs>sitePoints</storeAs>
          <sitePartsParams>$sitePartsParams</sitePartsParams>
        </li>

        <li Class="QuestNode_SubScript">
          <def>Util_GetDefaultRewardValueFromPoints</def>
          <parms>
            <points>$sitePoints</points>
          </parms>
        </li>

        <li Class="QuestNode_Multiply">
          <value1>$rewardValue</value1>
          <value2>1.75</value2>
          <storeAs>rewardValue</storeAs>
        </li>

        <li Class="QuestNode_SubScript">
          <def>Util_GenerateSite</def>
        </li>

        <li Class="QuestNode_SpawnWorldObjects">
          <worldObjects>$site</worldObjects>
        </li>

        <li Class="QuestNode_WorldObjectTimeout">
          <worldObject>$site</worldObject>
          <isQuestTimeout>true</isQuestTimeout>
          <delayTicks>$(randInt(10,22)*60000)</delayTicks>
          <inSignalDisable>site.MapGenerated</inSignalDisable>
          <destroyOnCleanup>true</destroyOnCleanup>
          <node Class="QuestNode_Sequence">
            <nodes>
              <li Class="QuestNode_Letter">
                <label TKey="LetterLabelQuestExpired">Quest expired: [resolvedQuestName]</label>
                <text TKey="LetterTextQuestExpired">The crew have stripped the assembly line out of the yard and moved it elsewhere. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has expired.</text>
              </li>
              <li Class="QuestNode_End">
                <outcome>Fail</outcome>
              </li>
            </nodes>
          </node>
        </li>

        
        <li Class="QuestNode_Signal">
          <inSignal>site.Destroyed</inSignal>
          <node Class="QuestNode_Sequence">
            <nodes>
              <li Class="QuestNode_Letter">
                <label TKey="LetterLabelQuestFailed">Quest failed: [resolvedQuestName]</label>
                <text TKey="LetterTextQuestFailed">The yard crew scattered after being discovered, taking the line with them. The quest [resolvedQuestName] has ended.</text>
              </li>
              <li Class="QuestNode_End">
                <outcome>Fail</outcome>
              </li>
            </nodes>
          </node>
        </li>

        <li Class="QuestNode_Signal">
          <inSignal>site.AllEnemiesDefeated</inSignal>
          <node Class="QuestNode_Sequence">
            <nodes>
              <li Class="QuestNode_Notify_PlayerRaidedSomeone">
                <getRaidersFromMapParent>$site</getRaidersFromMapParent>
              </li>
              
              <li Class="QuestNode_IsSet">
                <name>askerIsNull</name>
                <elseNode Class="QuestNode_GiveRewards">
                  <parms>
                    <allowGoodwill>true</allowGoodwill>
                    <allowRoyalFavor>true</allowRoyalFavor>
                    <chosenPawnSignal>ChosenPawnForReward</chosenPawnSignal>
                  </parms>
                  <addCampLootReward>true</addCampLootReward>
                  <customLetterLabel TKey="LetterLabelPaymentArrived">Payment arrived</customLetterLabel>
                  <customLetterText TKey="LetterTextPaymentArrived">The assembly yard has been shut down.\n\nThe payment from [asker_faction_name] has arrived.</customLetterText>
                  <nodeIfChosenPawnSignalUsed Class="QuestNode_Letter">
                    <letterDef>ChoosePawn</letterDef>
                    <label TKey="LetterLabelFavorReceiver">[asker_faction_royalFavorLabel]</label>
                    <text TKey="LetterTextFavorReceiver">These colonists took part in clearing the yard for the quest [resolvedQuestName]. [asker_definite] wants to know who should receive the [royalFavorReward_amount] [asker_faction_royalFavorLabel] for this service.</text>
                    <useColonistsOnMap>$site</useColonistsOnMap>
                    <chosenPawnSignal>ChosenPawnForReward</chosenPawnSignal>
                  </nodeIfChosenPawnSignalUsed>
                </elseNode>
              </li>
            </nodes>
          </node>
        </li>

        
        <li Class="QuestNode_End">
          <inSignal>site.AllEnemiesDefeated</inSignal>
          <outcome>Success</outcome>
        </li>
      </nodes>
    </root>
  </QuestScriptDef>


```

### QuestScriptDef:DMS_Stele — 

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Quests/DMS_Stele.xml`

```xml
<QuestScriptDef>
    <defName>DMS_Stele</defName>
    <successHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestSuccess_Occultech</successHistoryEvent>
    <failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestFailed_Occultech</failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>
    <isRootSpecial>true</isRootSpecial>
    <autoAccept>true</autoAccept>
    <defaultChallengeRating>4</defaultChallengeRating>
    <questNameRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        <li>questName-&gt;The buried stele</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questNameRules>
    <questDescriptionRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        <li>questDescription-&gt;With qubit decryption, our researchers can now pick up the faint authentication pulses of occultech glyphs: sealed cipher plates the colonial fleets dropped across this world. Each glyph carries one fragment of the key to a stele buried beneath this world, and the fleets scatter them so that no single find can open one.\n\nRecover [keysCount] glyphs and bring them home. Reading a full set will resolve where the stele lies and how to break its seal. Glyph sites will surface over time, and the Legacy remnants assigned to them are still standing guard.\n\nOnce the stele is home, a decoder set flush against it will extract its knowledge.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questDescriptionRules>
    <root Class="DMS.QuestNode_Root_Stele">
      <steleDef>DMS_OccultTechFont</steleDef>
      <keysCount>4</keysCount>
      <vaultQuestDef>DMS_SteleVault</vaultQuestDef>
      <subquestDefs>
        <li>DMS_SteleKey_ImpactSite</li>
      </subquestDefs>
    </root>
  </QuestScriptDef>

  
```

### QuestScriptDef:DMS_SteleKey_ImpactSite — 

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Quests/DMS_Stele.xml`

```xml
<QuestScriptDef>
    <defName>DMS_SteleKey_ImpactSite</defName>
    <successHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestSuccess_Occultech</successHistoryEvent>
    <failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestFailed_Occultech</failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>
    <autoAccept>true</autoAccept>
    <questNameRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        <li>questName-&gt;Impact site</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questNameRules>
    <questDescriptionRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        <li>questDescription-&gt;Our receivers have caught the authentication pulse of an occultech glyph. The fleets deliver glyphs to pioneer installations by orbital drop, and this capsule never reached its beacon: it came down hard, and the pioneers sheltered it where it fell. The Legacy remnants assigned to the impact site are still holding it.\n\nThe glyph is inside the shelter at the centre of the site. Take it and bring it home. If we leave it behind, it will be lost with the site.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questDescriptionRules>
    <questContentRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        <li>letterLabelMapGenerated-&gt;Glyph capsule wreckage</li>
        <li>letterTextMapGenerated-&gt;Wreckage from the glyph capsule is strewn around the pioneers' shelter, and the remnants guarding it have already noticed us.\n\nThe glyph is inside the shelter. It only counts once it is home.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questContentRules>
    <questAvailableLetterLabel>Occultech glyph found: Impact site</questAvailableLetterLabel>
    <questAvailableLetterTextIsDescription>true</questAvailableLetterTextIsDescription>
    <canOccurOnAllPlanetLayers>true</canOccurOnAllPlanetLayers>
    <root Class="DMS.QuestNode_Root_OccultechKey_Site">
      <layer>Surface</layer>
      <sitePartDefs>
        <li>DMS_SteleKey_ImpactSite</li>
      </sitePartDefs>
      <siteFaction>DMS_Legacy</siteFaction>
    </root>
  </QuestScriptDef>

    <defName>DMS_SteleVault</defName>

The reading collapsed their quantum states and the glyphs are spent, but the cipher they held has resolved: a stele lies buried in a sealed vault at the marked location, still guarded by Legacy remnants.\n\n[vaultInstructions]</li>
        <li>questDescription(retry==True)-&gt;The resolved glyph cipher still holds. With the last stele lost, it points to the next one: another sealed vault under Legacy guard, at the marked location.\n\n[vaultInstructions]</li>
        <li>vaultInstructions-&gt;Clear the vault, claim the stele, uninstall it and bring it home. It weighs [steleMass] kg, so plan the transport. If we leave it behind, it will be lost with the site.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questDescriptionRules>
    <questContentRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        <li>letterLabelMapGenerated-&gt;Stele vault</li>
        <li>letterTextMapGenerated-&gt;The stele stands at the centre of the vault, and the remnants guarding it are already moving.\n\nOnce the area is clear, claim the stele and uninstall it. It must leave this site with us.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questContentRules>

<QuestScriptDef>
    <defName>DMS_SupplyChain</defName>
    <successHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestSuccess_Logistics</successHistoryEvent>
    <failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>DMS_QuestFailed_Logistics</failedOrExpiredHistoryEvent>
    <rootSelectionWeight>0.6</rootSelectionWeight>
    <rootMinPoints>300</rootMinPoints>
    <defaultChallengeRating>1</defaultChallengeRating>
    <expireDaysRange>3~6</expireDaysRange>
    <questNameRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        
        <li>questName-&gt;Supply contract: [categoryLabel]</li>
        <li>questName-&gt;Supply request: [categoryLabel]</li>
        <li>questName-&gt;Staged deliveries: [categoryLabel]</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questNameRules>
    <questDescriptionRules>
      <rulesStrings>
        
        <li>questDescription-&gt;A logistics coordinator of [issuerFactionName], [asker_nameFull], has forwarded us a long-term supply request for [categoryLabel]. They need roughly [totalStages] shipments of [categoryLabel], around [approxTotalCount] units in total, to [supplyPurpose].\n\nAccording to [asker_possessive] figures, the first shipment calls for about [firstCount]x [categoryLabel]. If we agree to supply them, [asker_pronoun] will [deployMethod] to deploy a mobile cargo pod at [map_definite]. The first shipment must be loaded and launched within [deadlineDays] days to catch [freightWindow].\n\n[asker_nameDef] assures us that if the first shipment is delivered on schedule, follow-up [categoryLabel] contracts will continue to be offered to us first, and once every shipment is complete, we will be compensated for the price difference of the goods at market rates.</li>

        <li>supplyPurpose-&gt;keep their forward garrisons provisioned through the coming quadrums</li>
        <li>supplyPurpose-&gt;cover a shortfall in their planetside stockpiles</li>
        <li>supplyPurpose-&gt;provision the outposts scattered along their perimeter</li>
        <li>supplyPurpose-&gt;replace stores lost when a supply convoy was ambushed</li>

        <li>deployMethod-&gt;coordinate an orbital platform</li>
        <li>deployMethod-&gt;divert a dropship from its patrol route</li>
        <li>deployMethod-&gt;requisition a drop slot from the fleet's supply hub</li>

        <li>freightWindow-&gt;the bulk freighter's departure window</li>
        <li>freightWindow-&gt;the next orbital convoy assembly</li>
        <li>freightWindow-&gt;the fleet's scheduled logistics uplift</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </questDescriptionRules>
    <root Class="DMS.QuestNode_Root_SupplyChain">
      <subquestDef>DMS_SupplyChain_Delivery</subquestDef>
      <issuerNamePack>DMS_SupplyChainIssuer</issuerNamePack>
      
      <askerKind>DMS_Officer</askerKind>
      
      <pointsToChallengeRatingCurve>
        <points>
          <li>(100, 1)</li>
          <li>(1200, 1)</li>
          <li>(1800, 2)</li>
          <li>(4000, 2)</li>
          <li>(5000, 3)</li>
        </points>
      </pointsToChallengeRatingCurve>
      
      <pointsToStagesCurve>
        <points>
          <li>(100, 2)</li>
          <li>(1000, 3)</li>
          <li>(3500, 4)</li>
          <li>(8000, 5)</li>
        </points>
      </pointsToStagesCurve>
      <stagesJitter>-1~1</stagesJitter>
      <stagesClamp>2~5</stagesClamp>
      <countGrowthPerStage>1.6</countGrowthPerStage>
      
      <pointsToRequestValueCurve>
        <points>
          <li>(100, 300)</li>
          <li>(500, 800)</li>
          <li>(1500, 1800)</li>
          <li>(5000, 4200)</li>
          <li>(10000, 7000)</li>
        </points>
      </pointsToRequestValueCurve>
      
      <rewardMarkup>1.35</rewardMarkup>
      <rewardGrowthPerStage>1.1</rewardGrowthPerStage>
      <rewardValueCapFactor>1.5</rewardValueCapFactor>
      
      <massCapacityUseFraction>0.9</massCapacityUseFraction>
      
      <completionBonusFactor>0.4</completionBonusFactor>
      <giverFactionDef>DMS_Army</giverFactionDef>
      <stageDeadlineDays>10</stageDeadlineDays>
      <deadlineDaysPerStage>5</deadlineDaysPerStage>
      <stageIntervalDaysRange>10~15</stageIntervalDaysRange>
      <categoryPool>

        </li>

        </li>
        <li>

          <countFactor>0.5</countFactor>

        </li>

### RecipeDef:DMS_Make_ArtifuscleFromProtein — Grow artifuscle x5 (artiprotein)

來源：`1.7/Defs/Things_item/DMS_Recipe.xml`

```xml
<RecipeDef>
    <defName>DMS_Make_ArtifuscleFromProtein</defName>
    <label>Grow artifuscle x5 (artiprotein)</label>
    <description>Substitute artiprotein for the neutroamine and gold demanded by the conventional feedstock. It is in practice the more cost-effective route to artificial muscle, at the price of a far longer growth cycle.</description>

### ResearchProjectDef:DMS_Occultech_BionicSuitHeavy — enclosed assault frame

來源：`1.7/Defs/Research/DMS_OccultechProjects.xml`

```xml
<ResearchProjectDef>
    <defName>DMS_Occultech_BionicSuitHeavy</defName>
    <label>enclosed assault frame</label>
    <description>A load-bearing frame anchored directly into the pilot's skeleton, driven by artificial muscle bundles that only draw at full closure. It allows a single soldier to carry and operate armament far beyond their own muscular limit. Because closure is a precondition of output, the device cannot be released by any conventional means once sealed, and separation of the pilot must be performed surgically.\nThis inability to self-release classifies the device, under the laws of war, as restraining equipment upon its own pilot. The positive applications of its skeletal anchoring and load-transfer principles to prosthetic rehabilitation are nonetheless equally present.\n\nApproved by ███████ and ███, the enclosed assault frame and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Sale of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and its related technologies are to be progressively declassified once a colonial world's society attains class I standard.</description>
    <tab>DMS_ExpeditionalKnowledge</tab>
    <knowledgeCategory>DMS_Restricted</knowledgeCategory>
    <knowledgeCost>750</knowledgeCost>
    <techLevel>Spacer</techLevel>
    <researchViewX>1.00</researchViewX>
    <researchViewY>3.00</researchViewY>
    <prerequisites>
      <li>DMS_Artifuscle</li>
    </prerequisites>
    <discoveredLetterTitle>Sealed file I: enclosed assault frame</discoveredLetterTitle>
    <discoveredLetterText>Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology.\n\nThe heavy bionic suit can now be assembled at an artifuscle chamber. It lets its pilot carry and operate heavy weapons no ordinary soldier could handle.\n\nIt only works fully closed. Once a pilot is sealed in, it cannot be taken off by normal means and can only be stripped away destructively through surgery.\n\nThe fleets shelved this technology for a reason.</discoveredLetterText>
    <descriptionHyperlinks>
      <ThingDef>DMS_Apparel_BionicSuitHeavy</ThingDef>
      <RecipeDef>DMS_RemoveBionicSuitHeavy</RecipeDef>
    </descriptionHyperlinks>
  </ResearchProjectDef>

They synthesize neutroamine, edible artiprotein and comparable organic polymers at far higher efficiency than any conventional process, and require neither fields nor livestock to do it.\n\nApproved by █████ and ███, synthetic biology and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. ### ResearchProjectDef:DMS_Occultech_Frogman — directed chassis gestation

來源：`1.7/Defs/Research/DMS_OccultechProjects.xml`

```xml
<ResearchProjectDef>
    <defName>DMS_Occultech_Frogman</defName>
    <label>directed chassis gestation</label>
    <description>A sealed technique that cultivates artificial military organisms in place of printing mechs. A directed development sequence is written into an embryo, whose mesonuclear substrate then lays down synthetic-mechanical structure instead of biological tissue and matures on its own. The embryo is brought to term in a growth vat.\n\nFurther AMO development was stopped for good after a catastrophic incident in the Earth era. Self-developing military organisms do enormous harm to local society and productive capacity, and the technology has been proscribed ever since. The colonial fleets carry out the sanctions under this ban themselves, never through local authorities.\n\nUnlocks the XM132 Frogman and its development sequence.</description>

Culture an embryo at an artifuscle chamber, then bring it to term in a growth vat or a surrogate. The result is a biomatroid larva. Protect its gestation pod for five days and it will develop into a combat-ready Frogman.\n\nThe file carries a fleet prohibition notice. Producing AMOs is prohibited on any settled world, and the fleets enforce this ban in person.</discoveredLetterText>

    <description>Ultra-high-pressure fluid tears the deep bedrock apart and frees the hydrocarbons and rare volatiles trapped in fissures in the crust. Even long after the surface deposits are exhausted, it keeps drawing chemfuel and minerals from underground. The mineral-laden slurry the process discharges, however, leaves severe heavy-metal pollution all around it.\nAs a means of resource extraction its industrial efficiency is extremely high, but spreading the technique across industrial worlds that lack environmental ethics can degrade a planet's living conditions rapidly, to the point that it is no longer habitable.\n\nApproved by ████ and ██, hydraulic fracturing extraction and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Sale of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and its related technologies are to be progressively declassified once a colonial world's society attains class I standard.</description>

    <description>The design and production technology behind the total-war specification mechs and related equipment that the colonial fleets field against planet-scale hostile organizations and harmful entities. The manufacturing process of these mechs has been drastically simplified so that they serve better as high-performance weapons, produced and expended without pause over the course of a total war. Their performance, however, does not come from nowhere.\nAfter the main battle specification leak on colonial world ████, colonial fleets across sector ████ observed similar technology reaching interstellar pirates and spacefaring military regimes through arms dealers. The technology recovery programs each fleet carried out after the incident proved effective, and the main battle specification was sealed again after ████.\n\nTo prevent such an incident from happening again, however, approved by ████ and ██, the main battle specification and its related technologies are designated class II sealed technology. ### ResearchProjectDef:DMS_Occultech_QubitDecryption — qubit decryption

來源：`1.7/Defs/Research/DMS_OccultechProjects.xml`

```xml
<ResearchProjectDef>
    <defName>DMS_Occultech_QubitDecryption</defName>
    <label>qubit decryption</label>
    <description>A decoding technique that bypasses a stele's own verification layer and reads its data by directly measuring the quantum state held at each lattice site of its holographic storage plates. The stele's encryption rests on the assumption that no one outside the fleets can observe those quantum states without collapsing them; this technique simply chooses to accept the collapse. Every reading permanently destroys the region it reads. What is recovered can be archived for research, and what is lost can never be restored.\nThe technique was leaked by fleet deviants. Steles are the backup memory of every colonial world, and every stele scanned this way is a record that no one will ever be able to read again.\n\nApproved by ████ and ███, qubit decryption and its related technologies are designated class II sealed technology. Disclosure of such technology is prohibited, and any decoding equipment discovered is to be destroyed on site.</description>
    <tab>DMS_ExpeditionalKnowledge</tab>
    <knowledgeCategory>DMS_Sealed</knowledgeCategory>
    <knowledgeCost>1000</knowledgeCost>
    <techLevel>Spacer</techLevel>
    <researchViewX>3.00</researchViewX>
    <researchViewY>2.00</researchViewY>
    <prerequisites>
      <li>MicroelectronicsBasics</li>
    </prerequisites>
    <discoveredLetterTitle>Sealed file II: qubit decryption</discoveredLetterTitle>
    <discoveredLetterText>Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology. It contains a stele decryption technique leaked by fleet deviants.\n\nThe decoder can now be built. Set flush against a stele and supplied with power, it can extract the occultech knowledge stored in the stele.\n\nWith this method in hand, the colony can also trace the occultech glyphs scattered across this world. Recovering the glyphs will lead to a stele.\n\nThe fleets sealed this file to keep the data in the steles out of anyone else's hands. Every stele read this way is a permanent loss to the fleets.</discoveredLetterText>
    <descriptionHyperlinks>
      <ThingDef>DMS_OccultechExtractor</ThingDef>
      <ThingDef>DMS_OccultTechFont</ThingDef>
    </descriptionHyperlinks>
    <modExtensions>

        <quest>DMS_Stele</quest>

    <description>A line of self-supervising sentry weapons built for long-term garrison duty: a quadruped garrison mech for installation security, a large drone platform that flies cover for unmanned mother-drones, and an automated nest that launches FPV suicide drones at intruders. All three were designed specifically for pioneer colonization operations, which needed defenses able to hold a world alone for decades before the fleet arrived, so all three carry fallback directives in their control cores that keep them executing their last standing order until the chassis fails.\nUnder the laws of war, weapons that outlast the conflict they were deployed for are classed alongside minefields. The remnants still guarding this world's beacons and installations are what these patterns become once their makers are gone.\n\nApproved by ████ and ███, the garrison arsenal and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. ### ResearchProjectDef:DMS_Occultech_ZeroPoint — zero-point energy

來源：`1.7/Defs/Research/DMS_OccultechProjects.xml`

```xml
<ResearchProjectDef>
    <defName>DMS_Occultech_ZeroPoint</defName>
    <label>zero-point energy</label>
    <description>Draws energy from the quantum fluctuations of the vacuum itself. Once the principle is mastered, antiparticles can be consumed to produce solidified zero-point energy, which powers the most advanced machines and weapons. It is the threshold of transcendent technology. But the true cost of harnessing the void is something humanity has yet to fully understand.\n\nAfter the main battle ███ division that landed on planet ████ drove the transcendent machine ████ out of the planet's crust, where it had lain parasitic, in the year ████, colonial fleet ████ compiled a detailed account of how such transcendent beings are constituted and passed it by stele to the other colonial fleets operating in the Andromeda cluster. Because transcendent beings and their applications still contaminate the physical universe in ways that remain largely beyond control, disclosure of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and its related preventive technologies are to be declassified once a colonial world's society attains class II standard.</description>
    <tab>DMS_ExpeditionalKnowledge</tab>
    <knowledgeCategory>DMS_Occulted</knowledgeCategory>
    <knowledgeCost>1500</knowledgeCost>
    <techLevel>Spacer</techLevel>
    <researchViewX>5.00</researchViewX>
    <researchViewY>2.00</researchViewY>

      <li>MultiAnalyzer</li>
    </prerequisites>
    <discoveredLetterTitle>Sealed file III: zero-point energy</discoveredLetterTitle>
    <discoveredLetterText>Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology: the confinement principles behind solidified zero-point energy.\n\nThree devices can now be built. The zero-point generator core uses antigrain warheads as its catalyst and condenses solidified energy out of the vacuum, each warhead yielding 25 units over about a year. The zero-point reactor burns solidified energy for power, each unit supplying 6000 W for a full year. The reality anchor, built with solidified energy, stabilizes the space around it: nothing inside can exceed 120% of its natural limits, psycasts cannot be cast, and anomalous entities are suppressed.\n\nThis file is occulted. The fleets regard the knowledge itself as a contamination, and they will not forgive whoever holds it.</discoveredLetterText>

      <rulesStrings>
        <li>arrivedLetterLabel-&gt;Tribunal transport arrived</li>
