        <li>arrivedLetterText-&gt;The orbital transport requisitioned by [askerName] has landed. [defendantName] must board it to attend the [issuerFactionName] military tribunal. Hostilities are suspended while the proceedings hold.</li>

        <li>acquitLetterLabel-&gt;Acquitted: [defendantName]</li>
        <li>acquitLetterLabel-&gt;Verdict: not guilty</li>
        <li>acquitLetterText-&gt;Against expectations, [defendantName] mounted a compelling defense before the tribunal. [issuerFactionName] has extended formal recognition to us; our standing is now that of an ally. [defendantName] is being returned by drop pod.</li>
        
        <li>acquitNoAllyLetterText-&gt;Against expectations, [defendantName] mounted a compelling defense before the tribunal. The Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] has ruled the charges unfounded and ordered an immediate release, rank and record intact.\n\nThe incident is closed, but the sealed technology still in our hands keeps [issuerFactionName] at arm's length: relations return to neutral, and no further. [defendantName] is being returned by drop pod.</li>

        <li>verdictLetterLabel-&gt;Verdict: [defendantName]</li>
        <li>verdictLetterLabel-&gt;Sentence pronounced</li>
        <li>verdictLetterText-&gt;The Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] has pronounced sentence. In consideration of [defendantName]'s cooperation, the punishment is set at the minimum: demotion from [oldTitle] to [newTitle], and [detentionDays] days of detention, effective immediately.\n\nThe fleet will cover room, board and medical care for the duration.</li>
        
        <li>verdictLetterNoDemotionText-&gt;The Navigation Hall of [issuerFactionName] has pronounced sentence. [defendantName] holds no rank on the fleet's rolls, so there is nothing to strip: the punishment is [detentionDays] days of detention, effective immediately.

The fleet will cover room, board and medical care for the duration.</li>

        <li>returnAllyLetterLabel-&gt;[defendantName] returned: fleet's respect earned</li>
        <li>returnAllyLetterText-&gt;[defendantName] has served the sentence and been returned by drop pod.\n\nThroughout detention, [defendantName]'s bearing and testimony left a strong impression on the [issuerFactionName] officer corps.         <li>returnNeutralLetterLabel-&gt;[defendantName] returned</li>
        <li>returnNeutralLetterText-&gt;[defendantName] has served the sentence and been returned by drop pod.\n\n[issuerFactionName] considers the incident formally closed. Relations remain neutral: the ceasefire holds, but no warmth came of it.</li>

        <li>betrayLetterText-&gt;The court-martial arrangement with [issuerFactionName] has collapsed. The military police command has declared the proceedings void, and [issuerFactionName] has resumed hostilities against us.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </rulePack>
  </RulePackDef>

### SitePartDef:DMS_AirportSite — remnant airfield

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Quests/DMS_LegacySite_Airport.xml`

```xml
<SitePartDef>
    <defName>DMS_AirportSite</defName>
    <label>remnant airfield</label>
    <description>A Legacy remnant drone airfield. The control tower still runs a high-powered decoy radio tuned to the cluster weaver's command band: once the garrison is dealt with, the transmitter can call the mothership down onto the airfield instead of onto your home.</description>
    <workerClass>Fortified.SitePartWorker_FFF_TimedHostileSite</workerClass>
    <modExtensions>
      
      <li Class="Fortified.FFF_TimedSiteExtension">
        <baseEntryHours>48</baseEntryHours>
        <minEntryHours>12</minEntryHours>
        <maxEntryHours>96</maxEntryHours>
        <entryLetterLabelKey>DMS_Airport_EntryCountdownLabel</entryLetterLabelKey>
        <entryLetterTextKey>DMS_Airport_EntryCountdownText</entryLetterTextKey>
      </li>
    </modExtensions>
    
    <siteTexture>UI/Faction/LegacyIcon</siteTexture>
    <expandingIconTexture>UI/Faction/LegacyIcon</expandingIconTexture>
    <applyFactionColorToSiteTexture>true</applyFactionColorToSiteTexture>
    <showFactionInInspectString>true</showFactionInInspectString>
    <requiresFaction>true</requiresFaction>
    <wantsThreatPoints>true</wantsThreatPoints>
    <gravShipsCanLandOn>true</gravShipsCanLandOn>
    <minThreatPoints>800</minThreatPoints>
    <considerEnteringAsAttack>true</considerEnteringAsAttack>
    <disallowsAutomaticDetectionTimerStart>true</disallowsAutomaticDetectionTimerStart>
    <approachOrderString>Assault {0}</approachOrderString>
    <approachingReportString>Assaulting {0}.</approachingReportString>
    <arrivedLetter>You have arrived at the remnant airfield. A drone garrison holds the tower and the aprons.\n\nThe decoy radio in the tower is intact. Clear the field, then use it to call the cluster weaver down here, far from your colony.</arrivedLetter>
    <arrivedLetterDef>NegativeEvent</arrivedLetterDef>
    <tags>
      <li>DMS_AirportSite</li>
    </tags>
  </SitePartDef>

  
```

    <label>derelict remnant station</label>
    <description>A sprawling pre-war station, half of it collapsed, that a Legacy remnant detachment has dug into. Ancient supply crates and wrecked machinery are scattered through the ruins.</description>
    <workerClass>Fortified.SitePartWorker_FFF_TimedHostileSite</workerClass>
    <modExtensions>
      
      <li Class="Fortified.FFF_TimedSiteExtension">
        <baseEntryHours>40</baseEntryHours>
        <minEntryHours>10</minEntryHours>
        <maxEntryHours>80</maxEntryHours>
        <entryLetterLabelKey>DMS_SiteStation_EntryCountdownLabel</entryLetterLabelKey>
        <entryLetterTextKey>DMS_SiteStation_EntryCountdownText</entryLetterTextKey>
      </li>
    </modExtensions>
    
    <siteTexture>UI/Faction/LegacyIcon</siteTexture>
    <expandingIconTexture>UI/Faction/LegacyIcon</expandingIconTexture>
    <applyFactionColorToSiteTexture>true</applyFactionColorToSiteTexture>
    <showFactionInInspectString>true</showFactionInInspectString>
    <requiresFaction>true</requiresFaction>
    <wantsThreatPoints>true</wantsThreatPoints>
    <gravShipsCanLandOn>true</gravShipsCanLandOn>
    <minThreatPoints>400</minThreatPoints>
    
    <minMapSize>(250, 0, 250)</minMapSize>
    <considerEnteringAsAttack>true</considerEnteringAsAttack>
    <disallowsAutomaticDetectionTimerStart>true</disallowsAutomaticDetectionTimerStart>
    <approachOrderString>Assault {0}</approachOrderString>
    <approachingReportString>Assaulting {0}.</approachingReportString>
    <arrivedLetter>You have arrived at the derelict station. A remnant detachment is dug in among the ruins.\n\nThe station is large and the garrison is spread out; expect them to converge once the shooting starts.</arrivedLetter>
    <arrivedLetterDef>NegativeEvent</arrivedLetterDef>
    <tags>
      <li>DMS_SiteStationSite</li>
    </tags>
  </SitePartDef>

<StructureLayoutDef>
    <defName>DMS_CommandComplex</defName>
    <workerClass>DMS.DMS_LayoutWorker_Vault</workerClass>
    <canHaveMultipleLayoutsInRoom>true</canHaveMultipleLayoutsInRoom>
    <clearRoomsEntirely>true</clearRoomsEntirely>
    <minRoomWidth>9</minRoomWidth>
    <minRoomHeight>9</minRoomHeight>
    <corridorDef>DMS_VaultMainHall</corridorDef>

    <wallDef>DMS_SuperWall</wallDef>
    <doorDef>Door</doorDef>
    <doorStuffDef>Steel</doorStuffDef>
    <wallLampDef>DMS_EmergencyLamp</wallLampDef>
    <terrainDef>MetalTile</terrainDef>

    
    <roomDefs>
      <DMS_VaultEntranceHall>
        <countRange>1</countRange>
      </DMS_VaultEntranceHall>

      
      <DMS_VaultArmory>
        <countRange>2~5</countRange>
        <weight>0.5</weight>
      </DMS_VaultArmory>
      <DMS_VaultMechBay>
        <countRange>2~4</countRange>
        <weight>0.4</weight>
      </DMS_VaultMechBay>
      <DMS_VaultCommandRoom>
        <countRange>1~3</countRange>
        <weight>0.3</weight>
      </DMS_VaultCommandRoom>
      <DMS_VaultTreasury>
        <countRange>2~3</countRange>
        <weight>0.1</weight>
      </DMS_VaultTreasury>
      <DMS_VaultGarrisonQuarters>
        <countRange>1~99</countRange>
        <weight>1</weight>
      </DMS_VaultGarrisonQuarters>
      <DMS_VaultPowerPlant>
        <countRange>2~5</countRange>
        <weight>0.4</weight>
      </DMS_VaultPowerPlant>
      <DMS_VaultWreckHall>0.8</DMS_VaultWreckHall>
      <DMS_VaultAtrium>0.8</DMS_VaultAtrium>
      <DMS_VaultVehicleBay>0.6</DMS_VaultVehicleBay>
      
      <DMS_VaultMessHall>
        <countRange>1~4</countRange>
        <weight>0.4</weight>
      </DMS_VaultMessHall>
      <DMS_VaultInfirmary>
        <countRange>1~3</countRange>
        <weight>0.3</weight>
      </DMS_VaultInfirmary>

      
      <DMS_ArchiveOperations>
        <countRange>1~3</countRange>
        <weight>0.3</weight>
      </DMS_ArchiveOperations>
      <DMS_ArchiveServerHall>
        <countRange>1~2</countRange>
        <weight>0.1</weight>
      </DMS_ArchiveServerHall>
      <DMS_ArchiveTapeStore>
        <countRange>2~99</countRange>
        <weight>0.8</weight>
      </DMS_ArchiveTapeStore>
      <DMS_ArchiveCoolingPlant>
        <countRange>1~4</countRange>
        <weight>0.4</weight>
      </DMS_ArchiveCoolingPlant>
    </roomDefs>

    <junkScaterrers>
      <Filth_Trash>
        <groupsPerHundredCells>0~2</groupsPerHundredCells>
        <itemsPerGroup>2~4</itemsPerGroup>
        <groupDistRange>3~5</groupDistRange>
      </Filth_Trash>
      <Filth_Dirt>
        <groupsPerHundredCells>1~3</groupsPerHundredCells>
        <itemsPerGroup>2~4</itemsPerGroup>
        <groupDistRange>3~5</groupDistRange>
      </Filth_Dirt>
      <Filth_MachineBits>
        <groupsPerHundredCells>0~2</groupsPerHundredCells>
        <itemsPerGroup>2~4</itemsPerGroup>
        <groupDistRange>2~4</groupDistRange>
      </Filth_MachineBits>
      <Filth_RubbleRock>
        <groupsPerHundredCells>1~3</groupsPerHundredCells>
        <itemsPerGroup>3~8</itemsPerGroup>
        <groupDistRange>3~5</groupDistRange>
        <minGroups>1</minGroups>
      </Filth_RubbleRock>
    </junkScaterrers>

    <modExtensions>
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_VaultLayout">
        
        <roomWidthRange>11~16</roomWidthRange>
        <roomDepthRange>11~16</roomDepthRange>
        
        <branchCountRange>2~4</branchCountRange>
        
        <hubCountRange>2~4</hubCountRange>
        
        <hubSpacing>55</hubSpacing>
        
        <maxStraightLength>100</maxStraightLength>
        <jogOffsetRange>18~30</jogOffsetRange>
        <loopCountRange>1~2</loopCountRange>
        <loopSizeRange>31~39</loopSizeRange>
        <hubSize>17</hubSize>
        <hubArmWidth>11</hubArmWidth>
        <hubBranchChance>0.85</hubBranchChance>
        <subBranchChance>0.7</subBranchChance>
        <maxSubBranches>3</maxSubBranches>
        <branchSpacing>34</branchSpacing>
        <mergeChance>0.25</mergeChance>
        <gapChance>0.08</gapChance>
        <endRooms>true</endRooms>
        
        <sectorGap>6</sectorGap>
        
        <checkpointRoomDef>DMS_VaultCheckpoint</checkpointRoomDef>
        <checkpointChance>0.3</checkpointChance>
        
        <entranceDoorDefs>
          <li>DMS_RollingDoor_Triple</li>
          <li>DMS_RollingDoor_Double</li>
          <li>DMS_RollingDoor_Single</li>
        </entranceDoorDefs>
        
        <embedStructures>
          <li>DMS_Embed_A</li>
          <li>DMS_Embed_B</li>
          <li>DMS_Embed_C</li>
          <li>DMS_Embed_D</li>
        </embedStructures>
        <embedChance>0.5</embedChance>

        
        <sectorGates>true</sectorGates>
        <gateChance>1</gateChance>
        <gateDoorDef>DMS_SealedRollingDoor_Triple</gateDoorDef>
        <gateWallDef>DMS_SuperWall</gateWallDef>
        <gateConsoleDef>DMS_VaultGateConsole</gateConsoleDef>
      </li>
      
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_VaultDoors">
        <reinforcedDoorDef>Autodoor</reinforcedDoorDef>
        <reinforcedDoorStuff>Steel</reinforcedDoorStuff>
        <reinforcedDoorRatio>0.7</reinforcedDoorRatio>
      </li>
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_FacilityLockdown">
        <controllerDef>DMS_Building_LockdownController</controllerDef>
        <preferredRooms>
          <li>DMS_VaultCommandRoom</li>
          <li>DMS_ArchiveOperations</li>
          <li>DMS_VaultPowerPlant</li>
        </preferredRooms>
      </li>
      
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_VaultTunnels">
        <equipmentRooms>
          <li>DMS_VaultPowerPlant</li>
          <li>DMS_ArchiveCoolingPlant</li>
        </equipmentRooms>
        <extraRoomChance>0.3</extraRoomChance>
        <otherSectorChance>0.5</otherSectorChance>
        <secretRoomSize>6~8</secretRoomSize>
        <secretRoomFixtures>
          <li>
            <defs>
              <li>DMS_Building_VentSmall</li>
              <li>DMS_Building_VentMedium</li>
              <li>DMS_Building_VentLarge</li>
            </defs>
            <count>1</count>
          </li>
          <li>
            <defs>
              <li>DMS_Building_Machine_Medium</li>
              <li>DMS_Building_Eletric_Medium</li>
            </defs>
            <count>1~2</count>
          </li>
        </secretRoomFixtures>
        <floorDef>Concrete</floorDef>
        <hatchDef>Vent</hatchDef>
        <conduitDef>HiddenConduit</conduitDef>
        <substationDef>DMS_SubstationCabinet_Wall</substationDef>
        <corridorLinks>1~2</corridorLinks>
        <maxLegLength>45</maxLegLength>
        
        <crossSectorChance>0.5</crossSectorChance>
        
        <ventCenterStructures>
          <li>DMS_Room_VentCenter_A</li>
          <li>DMS_Room_VentCenter_B</li>
          <li>DMS_Room_VentCenter_C</li>
        </ventCenterStructures>
        <ventCenterChance>1</ventCenterChance>
        <ventCenterDistance>6~24</ventCenterDistance>
        <ventCenterLinks>2~4</ventCenterLinks>
        <ventCenterMaxLegLength>80</ventCenterMaxLegLength>
      </li>
      
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_GravekeeperPatrol">
        <squad>
          <li>
            <kind>DMS_Mech_Gravekeeper_Sepulturero</kind>
            <count>2</count>
          </li>
          <li>
            <kind>DMS_Mech_Gravekeeper_Enterrador</kind>
            <count>2</count>
          </li>
          <li>
            <kind>DMS_Mech_Gravekeeper_Velador</kind>
            <count>1</count>
          </li>
        </squad>
        <overwatchKinds>
          <li>DMS_Mech_Gravekeeper_Velador</li>
        </overwatchKinds>
        
        <squadSize>1~5</squadSize>
        <squadCount>1~5</squadCount>
        
        <chance>0.8</chance>
        <engageAlertLevel>0.6</engageAlertLevel>
      </li>

        </equipmentRooms>
        <extraRoomChance>0.35</extraRoomChance>

### TaleDef:DMS_Tale_Acquitted — acquitted

```xml
<TaleDef>
    <defName>DMS_Tale_Acquitted</defName>
    <label>acquitted</label>
    <taleClass>Tale_SinglePawn</taleClass>
    <type>Volatile</type>
    <baseInterest>2</baseInterest>
    <rulePack>
      <rulesStrings>
        <li>tale_noun-&gt;the acquittal of [PAWN_nameDef]</li>
        <li>image-&gt;[PAWN_nameFull] walking out of a hearing room [circumstance_group]</li>
        <li>image-&gt;[PAWN_nameFull] shaking hands with an officer [circumstance_group]</li>
        <li>image-&gt;[PAWN_nameFull] standing before a panel of officers [circumstance_group]</li>
        <li>image-&gt;[PAWN_nameFull] straightening [PAWN_possessive] uniform [circumstance_group]</li>
        <li>circumstance_phrase-&gt;without emotion or expression</li>
        <li>circumstance_phrase-&gt;without emotion or expression</li>
        <li>circumstance_phrase-&gt;with a [AdjectiveFriendly] expression</li>
        <li>circumstance_phrase-&gt;while standing perfectly straight</li>
        <li>desc_sentence-&gt;[PAWN_possessive] insignia is still in place.</li>
        <li>desc_sentence-&gt;[Quantity_adjphrase] officers sit behind a long table.</li>
        <li>desc_sentence-&gt;Unsigned papers lie on the table.</li>
        <li>desc_sentence-&gt;[Quantity_adjphrase] [PersonJob]s watch in silence.</li>
        <li>desc_sentence-&gt;In the distance, a [PersonJob] observes.</li>
      </rulesStrings>
    </rulePack>
  </TaleDef>


```

<ThingDef ParentName="BuildingBase">

    <thingClass>Building</thingClass>
    <description>A stabilization device that uses counter-technology to keep the surrounding space free from the influence of transcendent forces. To an ordinary person it is nothing more than a harmless decoration, but psycasters and transcendent artifacts find it hard to establish connections beyond this dimension in its presence, and cannot manifest their transcendent properties.\n\nWhile powered, it holds a stabilized field around itself. Inside it, no creature's capacities or physical limits can exceed 120% of normal, psycasts cannot be cast and invisibility fails. Anomalous entities and mutants are suppressed: slowed, weakened and far easier to contain. The field makes no distinction between friend and foe.</description>

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_ElevatorBase">
    <defName>DMS_ArchiveElevator</defName>
    <label>archive freight elevator</label>
    <description>The surface lift of a buried facility data archive. The colony fleet kept its records hosts underground, away from temperature swings, tremors and interference, and left only this lift up top. The car still has power, but its controls are locked. Hack it to bring the car up.</description>
    <portal>
      <pocketMapGenerator>DMS_DataArchive</pocketMapGenerator>
      <exitDef>DMS_VaultElevatorExit</exitDef>
      
      <pocketMapSize>120</pocketMapSize>
    </portal>
    <comps Inherit="False">
      
      <li Class="CompProperties_Hackable">
        <defence>20000</defence>
        <effectHacking>HackingTerminal</effectHacking>
        <lockoutDurationHoursRange>6~18</lockoutDurationHoursRange>
        <showProgressAfterHackCompletion>false</showProgressAfterHackCompletion>
        <notHackedInspectString>Hack to open.</notHackedInspectString>
        <intellectualSkillPrerequisite>4</intellectualSkillPrerequisite>
        <hackingCompletedSound>Hacking_Completed</hackingCompletedSound>
        <hackedMessage>{HACKER_labelShort} has finished hacking {SUBJECT_labelNoParenthesisDef}.</hackedMessage>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Sealable">
        <sealTexPath>UI/Commands/DMS_UnlockContainer</sealTexPath>
        <sealCommandLabel>Seal shaft</sealCommandLabel>
        <sealCommandDesc>Choose a colonist to permanently seal the lift shaft. Anything or anyone left below will be lost forever.</sealCommandDesc>
        <cannotSealLabel>Cannot seal</cannotSealLabel>
        <confirmSealText>Sealing the lift shaft is permanent. Anything or anyone left below will be lost forever.{0}\n\nAre you sure you want to continue?</confirmSealText>
        <sealedInspectString>Permanently sealed.</sealedInspectString>
        <cannotEnterLabel>Sealed</cannotEnterLabel>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Glower">
        <glowRadius>3</glowRadius>
        <glowColor>(90,200,160,0)</glowColor>
      </li>
      <li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_FacilityLockdownGate">
        <overrideWork>6000</overrideWork>
        <overrideSkillPrerequisite>6</overrideSkillPrerequisite>
      </li>
    </comps>
    <modExtensions Inherit="False">
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_PortalLayout">
        <genStep>DMS_DataArchiveStructure</genStep>
        <layout>DMS_DataArchive</layout>
      </li>
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_SealedGraphic">
        <sealedGraphicData>
          <graphicClass>Graphic_Multi</graphicClass>
          <texPath>Things/Building/Elevator_sealed/building</texPath>
          <drawSize>(5,5)</drawSize>
        </sealedGraphicData>
      </li>
    </modExtensions>
  </ThingDef>

### ThingDef:DMS_BF_RecoillessRifle — Recoilless rifle rack

來源：`1.7/Defs/Things_item/DMS_Modification.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="BaseModificationItem">
    <defName>DMS_BF_RecoillessRifle</defName>
    <label>Recoilless rifle rack</label>
    <description>A pair of 65mm recoilless tubes on a shared cradle, built to bolt onto the side pylons of a battle frame. Line units fit it for one reason: a frame's own light armament has no answer to plating or a prepared firing position, and a walking mount can carry the tube into ground a two-man crew would never reach.\n\nLoaded with shaped-charge rockets, the rack defeats armor and fortifications far above the frame's weight class, and its fire control unit reloads a spent tube from carried stores between engagements. The frame pays for it in walking pace, dodging room and cargo allowance, and every backblast marks its position for every observer on the field.</description>
    <descriptionHyperlinks>
      <HediffDef>DMS_BF_RecoillessRifle</HediffDef>

<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_AlertBuildingBase">

    <designatorDropdown>DMS_Uplinks</designatorDropdown>
    <description>An armored uplink terminal tied into the facility's alert network. When the sensors trip, it transmits the intruders' position to the nearest quick-reaction force, which arrives by drop pod shortly after to sweep the area. The transmitter burns out after a single call. Cut power or hit it with an EMP to disable it before dismantling.</description>

### ThingDef:DMS_Building_BlastScanner — blast scanner

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Things_Building/DMS_Buildings_Subsonic.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="BuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_Building_BlastScanner</defName>
    <label>blast scanner</label>
    <description>A precision geological survey device. A mortar shell loaded into its charge chamber drives a seismic shockwave deep into the ground, and the device reads the returning echoes to map ore deposits far below the surface. One charge maps several deep deposits at once.\n\nSurveying this way is never quiet. The shockwave all but inevitably wakes insect colonies dormant underground, and they tend to dig their way out close to whatever disturbed them.\n\nLoad a high-explosive shell, then light the fuse. The device needs time to recalibrate between charges.</description>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Building/DMS_Building_BlastScanner</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Single</graphicClass>
      <drawSize>(2,2)</drawSize>
      <shadowData>
        <volume>(0.6,0.6,0.6)</volume>
      </shadowData>
      <damageData>
        <rect>(0.2,0.2,0.6,0.6)</rect>
      </damageData>
    </graphicData>
    <uiIconScale>0.9</uiIconScale>
    <size>(1,1)</size>
    <altitudeLayer>Building</altitudeLayer>
    <passability>PassThroughOnly</passability>
    <pathCost>50</pathCost>
    <fillPercent>0.4</fillPercent>
    <rotatable>false</rotatable>
    <tickerType>Normal</tickerType>
    <designationCategory>DMS_Category</designationCategory>
    <terrainAffordanceNeeded>Medium</terrainAffordanceNeeded>
    <constructionSkillPrerequisite>5</constructionSkillPrerequisite>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>250</MaxHitPoints>
      <WorkToBuild>5000</WorkToBuild>
      <Flammability>0.5</Flammability>
      <Mass>35</Mass>
    </statBases>
    <costList>
      <Steel>100</Steel>
      <ComponentIndustrial>3</ComponentIndustrial>
    </costList>
    <researchPrerequisites>
      <li>DMS_Occultech_Subsonic</li>
    </researchPrerequisites>
    <placeWorkers>
      <li>PlaceWorker_ShowDeepResources</li>
    </placeWorkers>
    <comps>
      
      <li Class="CompProperties_Refuelable">
        <fuelLabel>charge</fuelLabel>
        <fuelGizmoLabel>Charge</fuelGizmoLabel>
        <fuelCapacity>1</fuelCapacity>
        <initialFuelPercent>0</initialFuelPercent>
        <fuelConsumptionRate>0</fuelConsumptionRate>
        <consumeFuelOnlyWhenUsed>true</consumeFuelOnlyWhenUsed>
        <autoRefuelPercent>1</autoRefuelPercent>
        <showFuelGizmo>true</showFuelGizmo>
        <targetFuelLevelConfigurable>false</targetFuelLevelConfigurable>
        <outOfFuelMessage>No charge loaded</outOfFuelMessage>
        <fuelFilter>
          <thingDefs>
            <li>Shell_HighExplosive</li>
          </thingDefs>
        </fuelFilter>
      </li>
      <li Class="DMS.CompProperties_BlastScanner">
        <fuseTicks>240</fuseTicks>
        <cooldownTicks>120000</cooldownTicks>
        <lumpCount>2~3</lumpCount>
        <infestationChance>0.8</infestationChance>
        <infestationDistance>6~16</infestationDistance>
        <infestationPointsFactor>0.6</infestationPointsFactor>
        <hiveCountLimits>1~4</hiveCountLimits>
        <igniteSound>Interact_Ignite</igniteSound>
        <detonateSound>Explosion_Bomb</detonateSound>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>

```

<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_AlertBuildingBase">

<ThingDef ParentName="BuildingBase" Name="DMS_LargeDoor">

    <label>heavy blast door</label>
    <designatorDropdown>DMS_BlastDoors</designatorDropdown>

    <designationCategory>FFF_DevCategory</designationCategory>

        <sensorDoorPathCost>50</sensorDoorPathCost>
        <sensorDoorWaitCostPerCell>12</sensorDoorWaitCostPerCell>
        <sensorDoorAllowManual>false</sensorDoorAllowManual>
        <moveSound>Door_OpenPowered</moveSound>
        <slideFleckDef>DustPuff</slideFleckDef>
        <slideFleckIntervalTicks>4</slideFleckIntervalTicks>
        <slideFleckScale>1.8</slideFleckScale>
      </li>
      <li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_AccessKeyDoorLink">
        
        <lockOnLink>true</lockOnLink>

      </li>
    </comps>
    <placeWorkers>
      <li>PlaceWorker_DoorLearnOpeningSpeed</li>
    </placeWorkers>
  </ThingDef>

<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_AlertBuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_Building_FPVHanger</defName>
    <label>FPV hangar</label>

    <description>An automated drone hangar used for facility defense. When alerted by the facility's other sensors, it automatically launches FPV drones to drive off or kill intruders, and it will also release drones to fight back when attacked. It is connected to the facility's underground logistics system below, so its expended drone stock is automatically replenished over time.</description>

    </graphicData>
    <uiIconScale>0.5</uiIconScale>
    <size>(3,3)</size>
    <rotatable>false</rotatable>
    <staticSunShadowHeight>0.7</staticSunShadowHeight>
    <costList>
      <Steel>50</Steel>
      <ComponentIndustrial>5</ComponentIndustrial>
    </costList>
    <comps>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Power">
        <compClass>CompPowerTrader</compClass>
        <basePowerConsumption>100</basePowerConsumption>
      </li>
      <li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_AlertEffector_ReleaseEntity">
        <listenSignal>FFF_AlertScanner_Triggered</listenSignal>
        <triggerChance>0.6</triggerChance>
        
        <oneShot>false</oneShot>
        <pawnKindDef>DMS_Drone_VerlingBrid</pawnKindDef>

        <scatterAroundParent>true</scatterAroundParent>
        <scatterRadius>3</scatterRadius>
        <spawnSound>DroneTrapSpring</spawnSound>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>

### ThingDef:DMS_Building_GasVent — gas vent

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Things_building/DMS_ExplorationBuildings_Alert.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_AlertBuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_Building_GasVent</defName>
    <label>gas vent</label>
    <description>A floor grate wired into the facility's alert network. When the alarm sounds, it hisses for a moment and then floods the area with toxic gas. The facility's mechanical garrison doesn't breathe; anyone else had better have a gas mask. It holds enough for a few releases and slowly refills from a tank below. Cut its power or hit it with an EMP to shut it down, even in the middle of a release.</description>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Building/DMS_Building_GasVent</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Single</graphicClass>
      <drawSize>(2,2)</drawSize>
      <damageData>
        <enabled>false</enabled>
      </damageData>
    </graphicData>
    <size>(1,1)</size>
    <rotatable>false</rotatable>
    
    <altitudeLayer>FloorEmplacement</altitudeLayer>
    <passability>Standable</passability>
    <pathCost>0</pathCost>
    <fillPercent>0</fillPercent>
    <blockWind>false</blockWind>
    <castEdgeShadows>false</castEdgeShadows>
    <staticSunShadowHeight>0</staticSunShadowHeight>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>200</MaxHitPoints>
    </statBases>
    <costList>
      <Steel>40</Steel>
      <ComponentIndustrial>2</ComponentIndustrial>
    </costList>
    <building>
      <isEdifice>false</isEdifice>
      <claimable>false</claimable>
    </building>
    <comps>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Power">
        <compClass>CompPowerTrader</compClass>
        <basePowerConsumption>50</basePowerConsumption>
        <shortCircuitInRain>false</shortCircuitInRain>
      </li>
      <li Class="DMS.CompProperties_AlertEffector_GasVent">
        <listenSignal>FFF_AlertScanner_Triggered</listenSignal>
        <triggerChance>0.8</triggerChance>
        <oneShot>false</oneShot>
        <gasType>ToxGas</gasType>
        <cellsToFill>60</cellsToFill>
        <durationSeconds>12</durationSeconds>
        <warmupTicks>120</warmupTicks>
        <cooldownTicks>600</cooldownTicks>
        <maxCharges>3</maxCharges>
        <rechargeTicks>60000</rechargeTicks>
        <warmupEffecter>FFF_Scanner_Alert</warmupEffecter>
        
        <releasingEffecter>ToxGasReleasing</releasingEffecter>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>

  
  
```

### ThingDef:DMS_Building_LauncherCase — launcher case

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_BuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_Building_LauncherCase</defName>
    <label>launcher case</label>
    <description>A wall-mounted emergency case holding a single light recoilless rifle, ready to be grabbed when the facility comes under attack. Anyone can pull the rifle out and shoulder it; the case then sits empty until someone loads a fresh one into it.</description>
    <thingClass>DMS.Building_RefuelableGraphic</thingClass>
    <designationCategory>DMS_Category</designationCategory>
    <designatorDropdown>DMS_DefenseEquipment</designatorDropdown>
    <researchPrerequisites>
      <li>DMS_EquipmentAdvanced</li>
    </researchPrerequisites>
    <category>Building</category>
    <useHitPoints>true</useHitPoints>
    <selectable>true</selectable>
    <tickerType>Normal</tickerType>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Building/LauncherCase/building</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Multi</graphicClass>
      <drawSize>2</drawSize>
      <drawOffsetNorth>(0,0,0.4)</drawOffsetNorth>
      <drawOffsetSouth>(0,0,0.3)</drawOffsetSouth>
      <damageData>
        <enabled>false</enabled>
      </damageData>
    </graphicData>
    <uiIconPath>Things/Building/LauncherCase/icon</uiIconPath>
    <passability>Standable</passability>
    <rotatable>true</rotatable>
    <fillPercent>0</fillPercent>
    <blockWind>false</blockWind>
    <castEdgeShadows>false</castEdgeShadows>
    <size>(1,1)</size>
    <altitudeLayer>BuildingOnTop</altitudeLayer>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>120</MaxHitPoints>
      <WorkToBuild>1500</WorkToBuild>
      <Mass>8</Mass>
      <Flammability>0.3</Flammability>
    </statBases>
    <costList>
      <Steel>40</Steel>
      <ComponentIndustrial>1</ComponentIndustrial>
    </costList>
    <killedLeavings>
      <ChunkSlagSteel>1</ChunkSlagSteel>
    </killedLeavings>
    <building>
      <isInert>true</isInert>
      <isEdifice>false</isEdifice>
      <isAttachment>true</isAttachment>
    </building>
    <placeWorkers>
      <li>Placeworker_AttachedToWall</li>
    </placeWorkers>
    <terrainAffordanceNeeded IsNull="True" />
    <modExtensions>
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_RefuelableGraphic">
        <emptyGraphicData>
          <texPath>Things/Building/LauncherCase/building_empty</texPath>
          <graphicClass>Graphic_Multi</graphicClass>
          <drawSize>2</drawSize>
          <drawOffsetNorth>(0,0,0.4)</drawOffsetNorth>
          <drawOffsetSouth>(0,0,0.3)</drawOffsetSouth>
          <damageData>
            <enabled>false</enabled>
          </damageData>
        </emptyGraphicData>
      </li>
    </modExtensions>
    <comps>
      
      <li Class="CompProperties_Refuelable">
        <fuelCapacity>1</fuelCapacity>
        <initialFuelPercent>0</initialFuelPercent>
        <fuelFilter>
          <thingDefs>
            <li>DMS_Gun_RecoillessLight</li>
          </thingDefs>
        </fuelFilter>
        <fuelLabel>Recoilless rifle</fuelLabel>
        <fuelGizmoLabel>Recoilless rifle</fuelGizmoLabel>
        <outOfFuelMessage>No recoilless rifle loaded</outOfFuelMessage>
        <fuelIconPath>Things/Weapons/DMS_RecoillessRifle_Light</fuelIconPath>
        <minimumFueledThreshold>1</minimumFueledThreshold>
        <consumeFuelOnlyWhenUsed>true</consumeFuelOnlyWhenUsed>
        <showFuelGizmo>true</showFuelGizmo>
        <showAllowAutoRefuelToggle>true</showAllowAutoRefuelToggle>
        <initialAllowAutoRefuel>true</initialAllowAutoRefuel>
        <autoRefuelPercent>0</autoRefuelPercent>
        <targetFuelLevelConfigurable>false</targetFuelLevelConfigurable>
        <drawFuelGaugeInMap>false</drawFuelGaugeInMap>
        <drawOutOfFuelOverlay>false</drawOutOfFuelOverlay>
        <hideGizmosIfNotPlayerFaction>true</hideGizmosIfNotPlayerFaction>
        <functionsInVacuum>true</functionsInVacuum>
      </li>
      <li Class="DMS.CompProperties_WeaponCase">
        <preloadWhenNotPlayerOwned>true</preloadWhenNotPlayerOwned>
        <takeTicks>90</takeTicks>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>

  
  
```

### ThingDef:DMS_Building_LockdownController — lockdown controller

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Things_building/DMS_ExplorationBuildings_Alert.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_BuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_Building_LockdownController</defName>
    <label>lockdown controller</label>
    <description>An emergency control unit that coordinates the blast gates at a buried facility's entrances. Once it completes a lockdown, the lifts in and out stop working. The unit is built to fail safe: if it is destroyed, the facility seals itself completely, and the doors can then only be opened with help from outside.\n\nIt engages when the facility's alert level reaches its maximum and seals the exits one minute later. Hacking it lifts the lockdown, and it can be hacked ahead of time. It runs on the facility's radioisotope cells, so cutting power does nothing; an EMP will only pause the countdown.</description>
    <category>Building</category>
    <selectable>true</selectable>
    <useHitPoints>true</useHitPoints>
    <tickerType>Normal</tickerType>
    <graphicData>
      
      <texPath>Things/Building/DistributionBox/building</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Multi</graphicClass>
      <drawSize>(3,3)</drawSize>
    </graphicData>
    
    <size>(2,1)</size>
    <rotatable>true</rotatable>
    <hasInteractionCell>true</hasInteractionCell>
    <interactionCellOffset>(0,0,-1)</interactionCellOffset>
    <fillPercent>0.7</fillPercent>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>500</MaxHitPoints>
      <Flammability>0</Flammability>
    </statBases>
    <building>
      <claimable>false</claimable>
      <deconstructible>false</deconstructible>
    </building>
    <comps>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Stunnable">
        <affectedDamageDefs>
          <li>EMP</li>
        </affectedDamageDefs>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Hackable">
        <defence>4000</defence>
        <effectHacking>HackingTerminal</effectHacking>
        <intellectualSkillPrerequisite>6</intellectualSkillPrerequisite>
        
        <lockoutDurationHoursRange>2~4</lockoutDurationHoursRange>
        <glowIfHacked>false</glowIfHacked>
      </li>
      <li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_FacilityLockdownController">
        <checkInterval>60</checkInterval>
        <countdownEffecter>FFF_Scanner_Alert</countdownEffecter>
        <lockedEffecter>FFF_Scanner_Trigger</lockedEffecter>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Glower">
        <glowRadius>3</glowRadius>
        <glowColor>(255,60,40,0)</glowColor>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>


```

### ThingDef:DMS_Building_SubsonicEmitter — infrasonic emitter

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Things_Building/DMS_Buildings_Subsonic.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="BuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_Building_SubsonicEmitter</defName>
    <label>infrasonic emitter</label>
    <description>A tower-mounted array of tuned infrasound emitters. While powered, it periodically releases a burst of infrasound that passes through walls and reaches every hostile living creature within range, wracking them with nausea and pain and sending many into a panic. It only fires when enemies are in range. Mechs are unaffected.</description>
    <descriptionHyperlinks>
      <HediffDef>DMS_SubsonicTrauma</HediffDef>
    </descriptionHyperlinks>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Building/DMS_Building_SubsonicEmitter</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Single</graphicClass>
      <drawSize>(2,2)</drawSize>
      <shadowData>
        <volume>(0.6,0.8,0.6)</volume>
      </shadowData>
      <damageData>
        <rect>(0.2,0.2,0.6,0.6)</rect>
      </damageData>
    </graphicData>
    <uiIconScale>0.9</uiIconScale>
    <size>(1,1)</size>
    <altitudeLayer>Building</altitudeLayer>
    <passability>PassThroughOnly</passability>
    <pathCost>50</pathCost>
    <fillPercent>0.4</fillPercent>
    <rotatable>false</rotatable>
    <tickerType>Normal</tickerType>
    <drawerType>MapMeshAndRealTime</drawerType>
    <specialDisplayRadius>9.9</specialDisplayRadius>
    <designationCategory>DMS_Category</designationCategory>
    <terrainAffordanceNeeded>Medium</terrainAffordanceNeeded>
    <constructionSkillPrerequisite>6</constructionSkillPrerequisite>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>200</MaxHitPoints>
      <WorkToBuild>6000</WorkToBuild>
      <Flammability>0.5</Flammability>
      <Mass>40</Mass>
    </statBases>
    <costList>
      <Steel>80</Steel>
      <ComponentStamped>4</ComponentStamped>
    </costList>
    <researchPrerequisites>
      <li>DMS_Occultech_Subsonic</li>
    </researchPrerequisites>
    <building>
      <ai_combatDangerous>true</ai_combatDangerous>
    </building>
    <comps>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Power">
        <compClass>CompPowerTrader</compClass>
        <basePowerConsumption>250</basePowerConsumption>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Flickable" />
      <li Class="CompProperties_Breakdownable" />
      <li Class="DMS.CompProperties_SubsonicEmitter">
        <pulse>
          <radius>9.9</radius>
          <hediff>DMS_SubsonicTrauma</hediff>
          <severity>0.25</severity>
          <panicChance>0.3</panicChance>
          
          <mentalState>FFF_FleeInPlace</mentalState>
          <earDamageDef>DMS_InfrasoundRupture</earDamageDef>
          <earDamage>2</earDamage>
          <hostileOnly>true</hostileOnly>
          <ignoreWalls>true</ignoreWalls>
          <fleck>PsycastAreaEffect</fleck>
          <sound>Explosion_EMP</sound>
        </pulse>
        <intervalTicks>900~1500</intervalTicks>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>

  
  
```

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_AlertBuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_Building_SubsonicEmitter_Security</defName>
    <label>security infrasonic emitter</label>
    <description>A tower-mounted infrasound array wired into the facility's alert network. It stays silent until the alarm sounds, then for about an hour releases burst after burst of infrasound through the walls at every intruder within range, wracking them with nausea and pain and sending many into a panic. The facility's mechanical garrison is unaffected. Cut its power or hit it with an EMP to silence it.</description>
    <descriptionHyperlinks>
      <HediffDef>DMS_SubsonicTrauma</HediffDef>
      <ThingDef>DMS_Building_SubsonicEmitter</ThingDef>
    </descriptionHyperlinks>

      <shadowData>
        <volume>(0.6,0.8,0.6)</volume>
      </shadowData>
      <damageData>
        <rect>(0.2,0.2,0.6,0.6)</rect>
      </damageData>
    </graphicData>
    <uiIconScale>1.2</uiIconScale>
    <size>(1,1)</size>
    <rotatable>false</rotatable>
    <fillPercent>0.4</fillPercent>
    <drawerType>MapMeshAndRealTime</drawerType>
    <specialDisplayRadius>9.9</specialDisplayRadius>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>300</MaxHitPoints>
    </statBases>
    <costList>
      <Steel>80</Steel>
      <ComponentStamped>4</ComponentStamped>
    </costList>
    <building>
      <claimable>false</claimable>
      <ai_combatDangerous>true</ai_combatDangerous>
    </building>
    <comps>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Power">
        <compClass>CompPowerTrader</compClass>
        <basePowerConsumption>100</basePowerConsumption>
        <shortCircuitInRain>false</shortCircuitInRain>
      </li>
      <li Class="DMS.CompProperties_AlertEffector_SubsonicEmitter">
        <listenSignal>FFF_AlertScanner_Triggered</listenSignal>
        <triggerChance>1</triggerChance>
        <oneShot>false</oneShot>
        <activeTicks>2500</activeTicks>
        <firstPulseDelayTicks>120</firstPulseDelayTicks>
        <intervalTicks>600~900</intervalTicks>
        <pulse>
          <radius>9.9</radius>
          <hediff>DMS_SubsonicTrauma</hediff>
          <severity>0.25</severity>
          <panicChance>0.3</panicChance>
          
          <mentalState>FFF_FleeInPlace</mentalState>
          <earDamageDef>DMS_InfrasoundRupture</earDamageDef>
          <earDamage>2</earDamage>
          <hostileOnly>true</hostileOnly>
          <ignoreWalls>true</ignoreWalls>
          <fleck>PsycastAreaEffect</fleck>
          <sound>Explosion_EMP</sound>
        </pulse>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>

    </modExtensions>

### ThingDef:DMS_CombatRegenSerum — combat regeneration serum

來源：`1.7/Defs/Things_item/DMS_Drug.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="MakeableDrugPillBase">
    <defName>DMS_CombatRegenSerum</defName>
    <label>combat regeneration serum</label>
    <description>A highly concentrated neuro-targeted agent laden with stem cells. It lets the body regrow missing parts to their original state within two to three days, but the process burns through enormous amounts of energy, so the patient must eat far more than usual to keep up. The pain of regrowth and the risk of rejection take a heavy toll on the subject's mental health, which is why agents of this kind are rarely seen on the rim.\n\nNon-addictive. Each dose carries a chance of triggering level 3 xeno limb syndrome.</description>
    <possessionCount>2</possessionCount>
    <descriptionHyperlinks>
      <HediffDef>DMS_CombatRegenHigh</HediffDef>
      <HediffDef>DMS_BionicShock</HediffDef>
    </descriptionHyperlinks>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Resource/Epipen_Regen</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_StackCount</graphicClass>
    </graphicData>
    <socialPropernessMatters>false</socialPropernessMatters>
    <rotatable>false</rotatable>
    <statBases>
      <WorkToMake>2500</WorkToMake>
      <MarketValue>150</MarketValue>
      <Mass>0.05</Mass>
      <Flammability>0.7</Flammability>
    </statBases>
    <techLevel>Spacer</techLevel>
    <ingestible>
      <drugCategory>Medical</drugCategory>
      <outcomeDoers>
        <li Class="IngestionOutcomeDoer_GiveHediff">
          <hediffDef>DMS_CombatRegenHigh</hediffDef>
          <severity>1.0</severity>
        </li>
        
        <li Class="DMS.IngestionOutcomeDoer_SetHediffLevel">
          <chance>0.25</chance>
          <hediffDef>DMS_BionicShock</hediffDef>
          <level>3</level>
          <partsToAffect>
            <li>Torso</li>
          </partsToAffect>
          <messageKey>DMS_CombatRegen_Rejection</messageKey>
        </li>
      </outcomeDoers>
    </ingestible>
    <recipeMaker>
      <researchPrerequisite>DMS_Occultech_Biosynthesis</researchPrerequisite>
      <recipeUsers>
        <li>DMS_TableArtifuscle</li>
      </recipeUsers>
    </recipeMaker>
    <costList>
      <Neutroamine>4</Neutroamine>
      <DMS_Artiprotein>10</DMS_Artiprotein>
    </costList>
    <comps>
      
      <li Class="CompProperties_Drug">
        <listOrder>1010</listOrder>
        <overdoseSeverityOffset>0.08~0.14</overdoseSeverityOffset>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>

  
```

### ThingDef:DMS_CommandComplexElevator — command complex freight elevator

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Vault/DMS_CommandComplex.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_ElevatorBase">
    <defName>DMS_CommandComplexElevator</defName>
    <label>command complex freight elevator</label>
    <description>The surface lift of a buried command complex. The colony fleet ran its regional operations from here: a whole district of barracks, armories, records halls and command rooms sealed under the rock, with only this lift up top. The car still has power, but its controls are locked behind the fleet's strongest encryption. Hack it to bring the car up.</description>
    <portal>
      <pocketMapGenerator>DMS_CommandComplex</pocketMapGenerator>
      <exitDef>DMS_VaultElevatorExit</exitDef>
      
      <pocketMapSize>300</pocketMapSize>
    </portal>
    <comps Inherit="False">
      
      <li Class="CompProperties_Hackable">
        <defence>60000</defence>
        <effectHacking>HackingTerminal</effectHacking>
        <lockoutDurationHoursRange>8~24</lockoutDurationHoursRange>
        <showProgressAfterHackCompletion>false</showProgressAfterHackCompletion>
        <notHackedInspectString>Hack to open.</notHackedInspectString>
        <intellectualSkillPrerequisite>8</intellectualSkillPrerequisite>
        <hackingCompletedSound>Hacking_Completed</hackingCompletedSound>
        <hackedMessage>{HACKER_labelShort} has finished hacking {SUBJECT_labelNoParenthesisDef}.</hackedMessage>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Sealable">
        <sealTexPath>UI/Commands/DMS_UnlockContainer</sealTexPath>
        <sealCommandLabel>Seal shaft</sealCommandLabel>
        <sealCommandDesc>Choose a colonist to permanently seal the lift shaft. Anything or anyone left below will be lost forever.</sealCommandDesc>
        <cannotSealLabel>Cannot seal</cannotSealLabel>
        <confirmSealText>Sealing the lift shaft is permanent. Anything or anyone left below will be lost forever.{0}\n\nAre you sure you want to continue?</confirmSealText>
        <sealedInspectString>Permanently sealed.</sealedInspectString>
        <cannotEnterLabel>Sealed</cannotEnterLabel>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Glower">
        <glowRadius>3</glowRadius>
        <glowColor>(220,70,50,0)</glowColor>
      </li>
      <li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_FacilityLockdownGate">
        <overrideWork>6000</overrideWork>
        <overrideSkillPrerequisite>6</overrideSkillPrerequisite>
      </li>
    </comps>
    <modExtensions Inherit="False">
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_PortalLayout">
        <genStep>DMS_CommandComplexStructure</genStep>
        <layout>DMS_CommandComplex</layout>
      </li>
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_SealedGraphic">
        <sealedGraphicData>
          <graphicClass>Graphic_Multi</graphicClass>
          <texPath>Things/Building/Elevator_sealed/building</texPath>
          <drawSize>(5,5)</drawSize>
        </sealedGraphicData>
      </li>
    </modExtensions>
  </ThingDef>


```

### ThingDef:DMS_CommandCoprocessor — Command Coprocessor

來源：`1.7/Defs/Things_item/DMS_Modification.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="BaseModificationItem">
    <defName>DMS_CommandCoprocessor</defName>
    <label>Command Coprocessor</label>
    <description>An auxiliary processing board fitted alongside a command automatroid's core processor. It takes over the signal multiplexing and unit bookkeeping that would otherwise occupy the main processor, letting the automatroid keep more units on its command chain at once.\n\nThe extra silicon draws power continuously, slightly increasing the automatroid's energy consumption.\n\nOnly command-type automatroids have a processor bus that can accept it.</description>
    <descriptionHyperlinks>
      <HediffDef>DMS_CommandCoprocessor</HediffDef>
      <ThingDef>DMS_Mech_Sergeant</ThingDef>
    </descriptionHyperlinks>
    <graphicData>
      
      <texPath>Things/Resource/ComponentCCC</texPath>
    </graphicData>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>80</MaxHitPoints>
      <MarketValue>1200</MarketValue>
      <Mass>1.5</Mass>
      <Flammability>0.5</Flammability>
    </statBases>
    <costList>
      <Plasteel>20</Plasteel>
      <ComponentControlChip>1</ComponentControlChip>
    </costList>
    <recipeMaker>
      <workAmount>6000</workAmount>
      <researchPrerequisite>DMS_Mechlink</researchPrerequisite>
      <workSpeedStat>GeneralLaborSpeed</workSpeedStat>
      <workSkill>Crafting</workSkill>
      <skillRequirements>
        <Crafting>8</Crafting>
      </skillRequirements>
      <recipeUsers>
        <li>DMS_TableMachinePrinter</li>
      </recipeUsers>
    </recipeMaker>
    <comps>
      <li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_AddHediffOnTarget">
        <compClass>Fortified.CompTargetable_AddHediffOnTarget</compClass>
        <hediffDef>DMS_CommandCoprocessor</hediffDef>
        <soundDef>DMS_EquipGear</soundDef>
        
        <targetBodyPartDefs>
          <li>ArtificialBrain</li>
          <li>DMS_ChestBrain</li>
        </targetBodyPartDefs>
        
        <supportRaceDefs>
          <li>DMS_Mech_Sergeant</li>
        </supportRaceDefs>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>

  
```

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_BossCallerBase">
    <defName>DMS_DecoyTransmitter</defName>
    <label>Decoy radio</label>
    <description>A high-powered radio, used fake radio signals to lure away the automated defense systems that still exist on the planet. Once activated, it puts out a powerful wave radiation signal which will attract ultra heavy automatroid to attack along with its escorts. If you can defeat it, you can collect the advanced technology from its corpse. The signal pulse burns out the transmitter, so this building can only be used once.</description>
    <descriptionHyperlinks>
      <ThingDef>DMS_Mech_ClusterWeaver</ThingDef>
      <ThingDef>ComponentControlChip</ThingDef>
    </descriptionHyperlinks>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Building/DecoyRadio</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Single</graphicClass>
      <drawSize>(3,3)</drawSize>
      <shadowData>
        <volume>(1.7, 0.75, 0.8)</volume>
        <offset>(0.15, 0, 0)</offset>
      </shadowData>
    </graphicData>
    <size>(3,3)</size>
    <costList>
      <Steel>50</Steel>
      <ComponentIndustrial>3</ComponentIndustrial>
      <ComponentSpacer>1</ComponentSpacer>
    </costList>
    <researchPrerequisites>
      <li>DMS_AdvancedControl</li>
    </researchPrerequisites>
    <comps>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Usable">
        <useJob>TriggerObject</useJob>
        <useLabel>Attract cluster weaver threat</useLabel>
        <useDuration>900</useDuration>
        <floatMenuFactionIcon>DMS_Legacy</floatMenuFactionIcon>
      </li>
      <li Class="DMS.CompPropertiesUseable_SummonRaid">
        <bossgroupDef>DMS_ClusterWeaver</bossgroupDef>
        <effecterDef>BurnoutMechlinkBoosterUsed</effecterDef>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_UseEffectDestroySelf">
        <delayTicks>120</delayTicks>
        <spawnKilledLeavings>true</spawnKilledLeavings>
        <effecterDef>MechbandBuildingDestroyed</effecterDef>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>


```

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="LampBase">
    <defName>DMS_EmergencyLamp</defName>
    <label>emergency lighting</label>
    <description>An emergency lighting system that automatically switches to its internal battery only when grid power is lost, glowing red for extended periods to maintain a minimum level of illumination even during an outage.</description>
    <designationCategory>DMS_Category</designationCategory>
    <designatorDropdown>DMS_DefenseEquipment</designatorDropdown>
    <researchPrerequisites>
      <li>DMS_EquipmentAdvanced</li>
    </researchPrerequisites>
    <altitudeLayer>BuildingOnTop</altitudeLayer>
    <tickerType>Normal</tickerType>
    <building>
      <isEdifice>false</isEdifice>
      <isAttachment>true</isAttachment>
    </building>
    <category>Building</category>
    <comps>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Flickable" />
      <li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_PowerWithInternalBattery">
        <basePowerConsumption>30</basePowerConsumption>   
        <chargeRateWatts>15</chargeRateWatts>              
        <internalBatteryMax>60</internalBatteryMax>        
      </li>
      <li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_PowerColorSwitch">
        <gridColor>(100,100,100,0)</gridColor>
        <batteryColor>(200,0,0,0)</batteryColor>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Glower">
        <glowRadius>5</glowRadius>
        <glowColor>(100,100,100,0)</glowColor>
        <colorPickerEnabled>false</colorPickerEnabled>
        <darklightToggle>false</darklightToggle>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Styleable" />
    </comps>
    <costList>
      <Steel>15</Steel>
    </costList>
    <drawerType>MapMeshOnly</drawerType>
    <drawPlaceWorkersWhileSelected>true</drawPlaceWorkersWhileSelected>
    <fillPercent>0.2</fillPercent>
    <filthLeaving>Filth_RubbleBuilding</filthLeaving>
    <graphicData>
      
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Multi</graphicClass>
      <texPath>Things/Building/Furniture/WallLamp/WallLamp</texPath>
      <drawOffsetNorth>(0,0,0.9)</drawOffsetNorth>
      <drawOffsetSouth>(0,0,-0.9)</drawOffsetSouth>
      <drawOffsetWest>(-0.9,0,0)</drawOffsetWest>
      <drawOffsetEast>(0.9,0,0)</drawOffsetEast>
      <damageData>
        <rect>(0.2,0.2,0.6,0.6)</rect>
        <enabled>false</enabled>
      </damageData>
    </graphicData>
    <leaveResourcesWhenKilled>false</leaveResourcesWhenKilled>
    <noRightClickDraftAttack>true</noRightClickDraftAttack>
    <passability>Standable</passability>
    <pathCost>0</pathCost>
    <placeWorkers>
      <li>PlaceWorker_GlowRadius</li>
      <li>Placeworker_AttachedToWall</li>
    </placeWorkers>
    <repairEffect>Repair</repairEffect>
    <rotatable>true</rotatable>
    <selectable>true</selectable>
    <soundImpactDefault>BulletImpact_Metal</soundImpactDefault>
    <statBases>
      <SellPriceFactor>0.7</SellPriceFactor>
      <MaxHitPoints>35</MaxHitPoints>
      <Flammability>1</Flammability>
      <WorkToBuild>450</WorkToBuild>
      <Mass>2</Mass>
    </statBases>
    <terrainAffordanceNeeded IsNull="True" />

### ThingDef:DMS_FacilityServerCore — facility server core

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_ServerBuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_FacilityServerCore</defName>
    <label>facility server core</label>
    <description>A sizable transistor computer. Old but extremely reliable, machines like this serve as paperless office and records hosts throughout the colony fleet's facilities. A special radioisotope cell inside keeps it running for years without anyone tending it.\n\nThe lower data layers of these server cores usually hold backups of important technical blueprints and access key records. Breaking into it will inevitably set off the whole facility's alarm response, so it is best to prepare your defenses before you start hacking.</description>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Building/AlertCaller/FacilityServerCore</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Single</graphicClass>
      <drawSize>(4,4)</drawSize>
      <shadowData>
        <volume>(1.8, 0.8, 1.6)</volume>
      </shadowData>
    </graphicData>
    <uiIconScale>0.8</uiIconScale>
    <size>(2,2)</size>
    <rotatable>false</rotatable>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>900</MaxHitPoints>
      <Mass>120</Mass>
    </statBases>
    <comps>
      <li Class="DMS.CompProperties_ServerHackable">
        <defence>1800</defence>
        <defencePerStage>600</defencePerStage>
        <stageCount>3~4</stageCount>
        <effectHacking>HackingTerminal</effectHacking>
        <intellectualSkillPrerequisite>6</intellectualSkillPrerequisite>
        <lockoutDurationHoursRange>6~12</lockoutDurationHoursRange>
        <glowIfHacked>false</glowIfHacked>
        <alertIncrement>35</alertIncrement>
        <alarmSound>FlickSwitch</alarmSound>
        <fallbackThing>DMS_DataCache_Restricted</fallbackThing>
        <rewards>
          <li>
            <kind>Techprint</kind>
            <weight>5</weight>
          </li>
          <li>
            <kind>Thing</kind>
            <thingDef>DMS_DataCache_Sealed</thingDef>
            <weight>3</weight>
            <maxPerBuilding>2</maxPerBuilding>
          </li>
          <li>
            <kind>AccessKey</kind>
            <weight>4</weight>
            <maxPerBuilding>2</maxPerBuilding>
            <keyWeights>
              <DMS_AccessKey_Nara>1</DMS_AccessKey_Nara>
              <DMS_AccessKey_Neutrals>1</DMS_AccessKey_Neutrals>
            </keyWeights>
          </li>
        </rewards>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>

  
  
```

### ThingDef:DMS_FrogmanEmbryo — frogman embryo

來源：`1.7/Biotech/Defs/DMS_Frogman_Gestation.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef>
    <defName>DMS_FrogmanEmbryo</defName>
    <label>frogman embryo</label>
    <description>A directed embryo carrying the XM132 development sequence. It is inert on its own. Brought to term by a human surrogate or cultured in a growth vat, it produces a biomatroid larva rather than a child.\n\nThe sequence overrides development completely, so the surrogate passes on none of her own genes. The mesonuclear substrate needs a host only for warmth and a blood supply, and colonial fleet doctrine used growth vats wherever they were available. Possession of a single embryo is enough to justify an interdiction.</description>
    <thingClass>DMS.MechEmbryo</thingClass>
    <category>Item</category>
    
    <tradeability>None</tradeability>
    <selectable>true</selectable>
    <useHitPoints>true</useHitPoints>
    <altitudeLayer>Item</altitudeLayer>
    <drawGUIOverlay>true</drawGUIOverlay>
    <alwaysHaulable>true</alwaysHaulable>
    <rotatable>false</rotatable>
    <pathCost>15</pathCost>
    <tickerType>Never</tickerType>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Resource/Wetware/Embryo</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Single</graphicClass>
      <drawSize>(0.85,0.85)</drawSize>
    </graphicData>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>60</MaxHitPoints>
      <Mass>0.5</Mass>
      <Flammability>0.2</Flammability>
      <DeteriorationRate>0</DeteriorationRate>
      <MarketValue>900</MarketValue>
      <WorkToMake>0</WorkToMake>
    </statBases>
    <thingCategories>
      <li>ItemsMisc</li>
    </thingCategories>
    <comps>
      <li Class="CompProperties_HasPawnSources" />
      <li Class="CompProperties_Forbiddable" />
    </comps>
    <modExtensions>
      <li Class="DMS.MechEmbryoExtension">
        <fixedGenes>
          <li>DMS_Gene_FrogmanGestation</li>
        </fixedGenes>
        <geneSetName>XM132 development sequence</geneSetName>
      </li>
    </modExtensions>
  </ThingDef>

  
  
```

### ThingDef:DMS_Gun_AutomaticGrenadeLauncher — mech grenade launcher

來源：`1.7/Defs/Things_Building/DMS_DeployableTurret.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="BaseWeaponTurret">
		<defName>DMS_Gun_AutomaticGrenadeLauncher</defName>
		<label>mech grenade launcher</label>
		<description>An automatic grenade launcher mounted on a low tripod.</description>
		<graphicData>
			<texPath>Things/Turrets/DMS_AutoGrenadeLauncher</texPath>
			<graphicClass>Graphic_Single</graphicClass>
			<drawSize>1.75</drawSize>
		</graphicData>
		<statBases>
			<Mass>20.70</Mass>
			<Flammability>0</Flammability>
			<RangedWeapon_Cooldown>4.8</RangedWeapon_Cooldown>
		</statBases>
		
		<comps>
			<li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_AmmoSwitch">
				<defaultIndex>0</defaultIndex>
				<includeDefaultAmmo>false</includeDefaultAmmo>
				<switchCooldown>240</switchCooldown>
				<soundSwitch>Artillery_ShellLoaded</soundSwitch>
				<ammos>
					<li>
						<label>HE grenade</label>
						<description>A high-explosive fragmentation round for clearing out clustered targets. The standard belt.</description>
						<iconPath>UI/Ammoswitch/40x46mm_HE</iconPath>
						<projectileDef>Bullet_DMS_GrenadeLauncher</projectileDef>
					</li>
					<li>
						<label>EMP grenade</label>
						<description>A capacitor round that stuns mechanoids and turrets in a small radius instead of destroying them. Useless against flesh, and the heavier fuze assembly slows the burst.</description>
						<iconPath>UI/Ammoswitch/40x46mm_EMP</iconPath>
						<projectileDef>DMS_Bullet_AGL_EMP</projectileDef>
						<warmUpFactor>1.1</warmUpFactor>
						<burstShotCountOverride>4</burstShotCountOverride>
					</li>
					<li>
						<label>smoke grenade</label>
						<description>A screening round that lays a smoke bank where it lands. Lighter than the explosive rounds, so it flies a little further and comes on target faster.</description>
						<iconPath>UI/Ammoswitch/30x29mm_Smoke</iconPath>
						<projectileDef>DMS_Bullet_AGL_Smoke</projectileDef>
						<rangeFactor>1.1</rangeFactor>
						<warmUpFactor>0.8</warmUpFactor>
						<burstShotCountOverride>3</burstShotCountOverride>
					</li>
				</ammos>
			</li>
		</comps>
		<verbs>
			<li>
				<verbClass>Fortified.Verb_LaunchProjectile_AmmoSwitch</verbClass>
				<defaultProjectile>Bullet_DMS_GrenadeLauncher</defaultProjectile>
				<requireLineOfSight>true</requireLineOfSight>
				<warmupTime>2.4</warmupTime>          
				<range>41.9</range>                   
				<minRange>0</minRange>
				<forcedMissRadius>1.2</forcedMissRadius>  
				<ai_AvoidFriendlyFireRadius>7.9</ai_AvoidFriendlyFireRadius>
				<ticksBetweenBurstShots>10</ticksBetweenBurstShots>
				<burstShotCount>7</burstShotCount>    
				<soundCast>Shot_IncendiaryLauncher</soundCast>
				<soundCastTail>GunTail_Medium</soundCastTail>
				<muzzleFlashScale>14</muzzleFlashScale>
				<targetParams>
					<canTargetLocations>true</canTargetLocations>
				</targetParams>
			</li>
		</verbs>
		<modExtensions>
			<li Class="MuzzleFlash.MuzzleFlashProps" MayRequire="IssacZhuang.MuzzleFlash">
				<def>MF_StandardMuzzleFalsh</def>
				<drawSize>(0.75,0.75)</drawSize>
				<offsets>
					<li>(0.75,0)</li>
				</offsets>
				<isAlternately>true</isAlternately>
			</li>
		</modExtensions>
	</ThingDef>

	
	
```

來源：`1.7/Defs/Things_Weapon/MilitaryGun_OneUse.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_BaseMakeableGun">
		<defName>DMS_Gun_RecoillessLight</defName>
		<label>light recoilless rifle</label>
		<description>A four-kilogram disposable recoilless launcher, issued down to squad level as a throwaway answer to armor, bunkers and doorways. The fibre-wound tube is discarded once fired, and its fire control unit accepts four interchangeable warheads, so the operator picks the effect before the tube ever reaches the shoulder.\n\nIt is light enough for a scout drone to carry, and its shaped-charge warhead defeats plating far above its own weight class, while the demolition and screening rounds let a single trooper open a wall or cover a withdrawal. The cost is that everything is spent in one shot: no reload, a short effective range, and a backblast signature that tells every gun on the field where the operator is standing.</description>
		
		<tradeTags>
			<li>DMS_WeaponRanged</li>
			<li>WeaponRanged</li>
		</tradeTags>
		<thingSetMakerTags>
			<li>RewardStandardHighFreq</li>
		</thingSetMakerTags>
		<weaponClasses>
			<li>RangedHeavy</li>
			<li>Ranged</li>
		</weaponClasses>
		<weaponTags>
			<li>DMS_Gun_RecoillessLight</li>
			<li>NoSwitch</li>
		</weaponTags>
		<uiIconScale>1.1</uiIconScale>
		<graphicData>
			<texPath>Things/Weapons/DMS_RecoillessRifle_Light</texPath>
			<drawSize>1.8</drawSize>
		</graphicData>
		<soundInteract>Artillery_ShellLoaded</soundInteract>
		<tickerType>Normal</tickerType>
		<statBases>
			<Mass>4</Mass>
			<WorkToMake>16000</WorkToMake>
			<MarketValue>210</MarketValue>
			<MaxHitPoints>90</MaxHitPoints>
			<AccuracyTouch>0.80</AccuracyTouch>
			<AccuracyShort>0.90</AccuracyShort>
			<AccuracyMedium>0.75</AccuracyMedium>
			<AccuracyLong>0.55</AccuracyLong>
			<RangedWeapon_Cooldown>3</RangedWeapon_Cooldown>
		</statBases>
		
		<recipeMaker>
			<researchPrerequisites Inherit="False">
				<li>DMS_MechBasis</li>
			</researchPrerequisites>
			<skillRequirements>
				<Crafting>5</Crafting>
			</skillRequirements>
		</recipeMaker>
		
		<costList>
			<Tungsteel>15</Tungsteel>
			<Steel>35</Steel>
			<Chemfuel>45</Chemfuel>
			<ComponentStamped>2</ComponentStamped>
		</costList>
		<smeltable>false</smeltable>
		<burnableByRecipe>false</burnableByRecipe>
		<tools Inherit="False">
			<li>
				<label>tube</label>
				<capacities>
					<li>Blunt</li>
				</capacities>
				<power>9</power>
				<cooldownTime>2.2</cooldownTime>
			</li>
		</tools>
		<verbs>
			<li>
				<verbClass>Fortified.Verb_Shoot_AmmoSwitch</verbClass>
				<hasStandardCommand>true</hasStandardCommand>
				<defaultProjectile>DMS_Bullet_LRR_HE</defaultProjectile>
				<warmupTime>2.0</warmupTime>
				<minRange>3.9</minRange>
				<range>29.9</range>
				<burstShotCount>1</burstShotCount>
				<soundCast>RocketswarmLauncher_Fire</soundCast>
				<soundCastTail>GunTail_Heavy</soundCastTail>
				<muzzleFlashScale>16</muzzleFlashScale>
				<onlyManualCast>false</onlyManualCast>
				<ai_IsBuildingDestroyer>true</ai_IsBuildingDestroyer>
				<ai_AvoidFriendlyFireRadius>5</ai_AvoidFriendlyFireRadius>
				<targetParams>
					<canTargetLocations>true</canTargetLocations>
					<canTargetBuildings>true</canTargetBuildings>
					<canTargetPawns>true</canTargetPawns>
				</targetParams>
				<forcedMissRadius>1.2</forcedMissRadius>
			</li>
		</verbs>
		<comps>
			
			<li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_AmmoSwitch">
				<defaultIndex>0</defaultIndex>
				<includeDefaultAmmo>false</includeDefaultAmmo>
				<switchCooldown>120</switchCooldown>
				<soundSwitch>Artillery_ShellLoaded</soundSwitch>
				<ammos>
					<li>
						<label>HE-frag</label>
						<description>A high-explosive round with a wide blast but ordinary penetration. Best used against groups of unarmored targets.</description>
						<iconPath>UI/Ammoswitch/Shell_HE</iconPath>
						<projectileDef>DMS_Bullet_LRR_HE</projectileDef>
					</li>
					<li>
						<label>shaped-charge</label>
						<description>A chemical-energy penetrator with a small blast but very high armor penetration. Best used against heavily armored targets.</description>
						<iconPath>UI/Ammoswitch/Shell_HEAT</iconPath>
						<projectileDef>DMS_Bullet_LRR_HEAT</projectileDef>
						<accuracyFactor>1.2</accuracyFactor>
					</li>
					<li>
						<label>demolition</label>
						<description>A high-explosive round specialized against structures, able to tear down turrets, walls and other high-durability targets.</description>
						<iconPath>UI/Ammoswitch/Shell_HESH</iconPath>
						<projectileDef>DMS_Bullet_LRR_Demolition</projectileDef>
						<rangeFactor>0.75</rangeFactor>
						<warmUpFactor>1.15</warmUpFactor>
					</li>
					<li>
						<label>airburst smoke</label>
						<description>A support warhead that bursts into a smoke screen over the point of impact.</description>
						<iconPath>UI/Ammoswitch/Shell_Smoke</iconPath>
						<projectileDef>DMS_Bullet_LRR_Smoke</projectileDef>
						<rangeFactor>1.5</rangeFactor>
						<accuracyFactor>0.9</accuracyFactor>
						<warmUpFactor>0.8</warmUpFactor>
					</li>
					<li>
						<label>firefoam</label>
						<description>A firefighting round that bursts into a spray of fire-retardant foam, smothering flames across a wide area and leaving a layer of foam that keeps them from catching again. It does no damage.</description>
						<iconPath>UI/Ammoswitch/Shell_Firefoam</iconPath>
						<projectileDef>DMS_Bullet_LRR_Firefoam</projectileDef>
						<rangeFactor>1.5</rangeFactor>
						<accuracyFactor>0.9</accuracyFactor>
						<warmUpFactor>0.8</warmUpFactor>
					</li>
				</ammos>
			</li>
			
			<li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_WeaponReloadable">
				<maxCharges>1</maxCharges>
				<destroyOnEmpty>true</destroyOnEmpty>
				<hotKey>Misc4</hotKey>
				<chargeNoun>charge</chargeNoun>
				<displayGizmoWhileUndrafted>false</displayGizmoWhileUndrafted>
			</li>
		</comps>
		<modExtensions>
			<li Class="MuzzleFlash.MuzzleFlashProps" MayRequire="IssacZhuang.MuzzleFlash">
				<def>MF_StandardMuzzleFalsh</def>
				<drawSize>(1.1,1.1)</drawSize>

			</li>
			<li Class="Fortified.HeavyEquippableExtension">
				<EquippableDef>AverageHumanCanUse</EquippableDef>
			</li>
		</modExtensions>
	</ThingDef>

### ThingDef:DMS_Hopper — feed hopper

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Things_Building/DMS_Production_Hopper.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="BuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_Hopper</defName>
    <label>feed hopper</label>
    <description>A gravity-fed bulk hopper with a powered auger in its base to move the coarse material that a normal conveyor line cannot handle, such as stone chunks, slag and mech wreckage.\n\nAutonomous production buildings linked to this hopper draw material straight out of it, so nothing has to be carried in by hand. Cutting the power stops the feed.</description>
    <thingClass>Building_Storage</thingClass>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Building/DMSHopper/building</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Multi</graphicClass>
      <drawSize>(3,2)</drawSize>
      <damageData>
        <cornerTL>Damage/Corner</cornerTL>
        <cornerTR>Damage/Corner</cornerTR>
        <cornerBL>Damage/Corner</cornerBL>
        <cornerBR>Damage/Corner</cornerBR>
      </damageData>
    </graphicData>
    <size>(2,1)</size>
    <rotatable>true</rotatable>
    <defaultPlacingRot>South</defaultPlacingRot>
    <altitudeLayer>Building</altitudeLayer>
    
    <drawerType>MapMeshAndRealTime</drawerType>
    <passability>PassThroughOnly</passability>
    <pathCost>42</pathCost>
    <fillPercent>0.5</fillPercent>
    <canOverlapZones>false</canOverlapZones>
    <castEdgeShadows>true</castEdgeShadows>
    <staticSunShadowHeight>0.35</staticSunShadowHeight>
    <surfaceType>Item</surfaceType>
    <tickerType>Rare</tickerType>
    <leaveResourcesWhenKilled>true</leaveResourcesWhenKilled>
    <constructEffect>ConstructMetal</constructEffect>
    <repairEffect>Repair</repairEffect>
    <soundImpactDefault>BulletImpact_Metal</soundImpactDefault>
    <filthLeaving>Filth_RubbleBuilding</filthLeaving>
    <terrainAffordanceNeeded>Medium</terrainAffordanceNeeded>
    <designationCategory>DMS_Category</designationCategory>
    <minifiedDef>MinifiedThing</minifiedDef>
    <thingCategories>
      <li>BuildingsMisc</li>
    </thingCategories>
    <constructionSkillPrerequisite>4</constructionSkillPrerequisite>
    <researchPrerequisites>
      <li>DMS_Material</li>
    </researchPrerequisites>
    <costList>
      <Steel>80</Steel>
      <ComponentIndustrial>2</ComponentIndustrial>
    </costList>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>250</MaxHitPoints>
      <WorkToBuild>1500</WorkToBuild>
      <Mass>45</Mass>
      <Flammability>0</Flammability>
      <SellPriceFactor>0.7</SellPriceFactor>
    </statBases>
    <inspectorTabs>
      <li>ITab_Storage</li>
    </inspectorTabs>
    <building>
      <destroySound>BuildingDestroyed_Metal_Small</destroySound>
      <blueprintClass>Blueprint_Storage</blueprintClass>
      <storageGroupTag>DMS_Hopper</storageGroupTag>
      
      <maxItemsInCell>3</maxItemsInCell>
      <ignoreStoredThingsBeauty>true</ignoreStoredThingsBeauty>
      
      <fixedStorageSettings>
        <filter>
          <categories>
            <li>Chunks</li>
            <li>Corpses</li>
            <li>FoodRaw</li>
          </categories>
          
          <stuffCategoriesToAllow>
            <li>Woody</li>
          </stuffCategoriesToAllow>
        </filter>
      </fixedStorageSettings>
      
      <defaultStorageSettings>
        <priority>Important</priority>
        <filter>
          <categories>
            <li>Chunks</li>
            <li>CorpsesAnimal</li>
          </categories>
        </filter>
      </defaultStorageSettings>
    </building>
    <comps>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Power">
        <compClass>CompPowerTrader</compClass>
        <basePowerConsumption>50</basePowerConsumption>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Flickable" />
      <li Class="CompProperties_Facility">
        
        <maxSimultaneous>4</maxSimultaneous>
        <maxDistance>6</maxDistance>
      </li>
    </comps>
    <placeWorkers>
      <li>PlaceWorker_ShowFacilitiesConnections</li>
    </placeWorkers>
    <modExtensions>
      <li Class="Fortified.ModExtension_MaterialSource">
        
        <allowWhileInactive>false</allowWhileInactive>
        
        <respectReservations>true</respectReservations>
      </li>
    </modExtensions>
  </ThingDef>


```

### ThingDef:DMS_Mech_BullHound — bullhound

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Things_Race/Races_Automatroid_BullHound.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_MechBullHoundBase">
    <defName>DMS_Mech_BullHound</defName>
    <label>bullhound</label>
    <description>A heavy quadruped automatroid built for garrison duty. An enlarged derivative of the Dogge, it gives up the artificial-muscle agility of its smaller cousin for thick plating and a fixed back mount, and was posted at gates and corridor junctions of remnant installations to stop intruders at close range.

This model mounts an automatic shotgun. The mount is fixed and cannot be swapped.</description>
    <comps>
      <li Class="Fortified.CompPropertiesMultipleTurretGun">
        <subTurrets>
          <li>
            <ID>autoshotgun</ID>
            <turret>DMS_BullHound_ShotgunMounted</turret>
            <autoAttack>true</autoAttack>
            <warmingTime>1.5</warmingTime>
            <angleOffset>-90</angleOffset>
            <renderNodeProperties>
              <li>
                <nodeClass>Fortified.PawnRenderNode_SubTurretGun</nodeClass>
                <workerClass>Fortified.PawnRenderNodeWorker_SubTurretGun</workerClass>
                <parentTagDef>Body</parentTagDef>
                <baseLayer>20</baseLayer>
                <pawnType>Any</pawnType>
                
                <drawData>
                  <dataNorth>
                    <offset>(0,0,0.05)</offset>
                  </dataNorth>
                  <dataSouth>
                    <offset>(0,0,0.35)</offset>
                  </dataSouth>
                  <dataEast>
                    <offset>(-0.05,0,0.3)</offset>

While not yet a contender during the total warfare,it still remains one of the most feared threats among local African armed groups after World War III, second only to the Wyvern flocks.\n\nCluster weaver uses a metal-reinforced carbon fiber frame as its main structural material and has virtually no additional armor. ### ThingDef:DMS_Mech_Frogman — Frogman

來源：`1.7/Defs/Things_Race/Races_Synthroid_Frogman.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_ArtificialOrganismHumanlikeBase">
    <defName>DMS_Mech_Frogman</defName>
    <label>Frogman</label>
    <description>The XM132 Frogman is the earliest artificial military organism on known record. Its mesonuclear biological design lets it be cultured in any environment and develop itself into designated adult.\n\nIn the Earth era, such biomatroid AMOs represented was briefly held to be the technology that would replace synthetic mechs and conventional mechanoids alike. A single severe incident ended that line of development for good.\n\nThe adult form is humanlike. It grows its own highly sealed composite plasfibre integument and a closed-loop internal cooling system. Every joint cavity is pressure-compensated and packed with dielectric gel, so it can swim in, wade ashore and go straight into combat. Earth-era marine corps used them for beach reconnaissance, harbour demolition and boarding actions.\n\nAMO technology is tightly controlled under the colonial fleet programme. That is why a bioweapon this well suited to local conditions remains a rare sight across the rim.</description>
    <thingClass>Fortified.ArtificialOrganismHumanlike</thingClass>
    
    <tradeability>None</tradeability>
    <uiIconPath>Things/Synthroid/icon_frogman</uiIconPath>

### ThingDef:DMS_Mech_Gravekeeper — gravekeeper

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Things_Race/Races_Automatroid_Gravekeeper.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_MechGravekeeperBase">
    <defName>DMS_Mech_Gravekeeper</defName>
    <label>gravekeeper</label>
    <description>A highly intelligent large automatroid, deployed by the colonial fleets specifically to patrol and guard important unmanned installations. Its parts are largely interchangeable with the mobile dragoon's, and it pairs excellent close-quarters combat ability with a formidable weapon system. The gravekeeper's design dates back to the lunar war of independence after the Universal Century, when most of the fighting took place in the narrow, enclosed tunnels of underground cities. Heavily armored mechs like the gravekeeper and the siegebreaker, carrying heavy weapons and able to suppress at close range, became the spearhead of both sides' fight for control of those tunnels.\nBecause of this specialized design, gravekeepers usually hold a defense in groups of five. Since they must patrol unattended installations for centuries, their rules of engagement are more conservative than an ordinary mech's, so that failing mechanisms do not trigger by mistake mid-mission. As a result, they will not leave their installation to engage an enemy on their own.\n\nThis pattern carries no shoulder rack.</description>
  </ThingDef>

  
```

<ThingDef ParentName="BuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_OccultTechFont</defName>
    <label>Stele</label>
    <description>A databank holding technical data and backups of colonial records, along with case analyses and post-incident reviews of every accident that has occurred across all colonization programs to date. A stele serves both as the medium through which the colonial fleets share experience and knowledge with their kin across star systems, and as a backup database buried deep beneath every colonized world. Complex encryption and verification algorithms keep its records from being lost over long voyages through space or ages sealed underground, while also preventing anyone outside the colonial fleets from obtaining the dangerous technology within.\n\nRumor has it that decoding techniques leaked by fleet deviants can perform a destructive scan to extract the data inside, but using such techniques may draw the hostility of the colonial fleets.</description>

    <description>A destructive decoding rig. It fires a high-energy laser through the holographic storage plates inside a stele and analyzes the scattered spectrum to read the data within: the only way for factions outside the colonial fleets to access a stele's contents. Set it flush against a stele and supply power, and it will continuously extract the knowledge and file it into your expeditional research, no researcher required. Extraction stops if the stele runs dry, power is lost, or no stele is in front of it. It can be uninstalled and reinstalled elsewhere.</description>

### ThingDef:DMS_SageCore — SAGE
