```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_ServerBuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_SageCore</defName>
    <label>SAGE</label>
    <description>A distributed strategic command computer that can take on auxiliary racks without limit, adding computing power as demand grows. The colony fleet uses it for planetary strategic air defense and to link the countless radar tracking and navigation networks spread across several continents. Destroying it is certain to cripple the fleet's hunting operations on the planet, though within a year or two another computer in the SAGE network will be promoted to host and carry on the task.\n\nIts lower storage still keeps copies of parts of the strategic database. Hacking it will bring the whole facility's alarm system down on you.</description>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Building/AlertCaller/Sage</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Multi</graphicClass>
      <drawSize>(5,3)</drawSize>
```

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="MakeableDrugPillBase">
    <defName>DMS_SensibilityBlocker</defName>
    <label>sensibility blocker</label>
    <description>A highly concentrated neuro-targeted agent that suppresses the receptors behind affective thought. Outwardly, the subject's aversion to their surroundings all but vanishes for as long as it lasts, which once made it a standard combat drug for exoskeleton pilots on long missions. Subjects keep a complete memory of the experience after it wears off, however, and once it was found to cause possible sensory loss its use was gradually banned.\n\nTemporarily suspends secondary needs such as beauty, comfort, outdoors, indoors and space, and negates the mood penalties of environment-related thoughts.</description>
    <possessionCount>3</possessionCount>
    <descriptionHyperlinks>
      <HediffDef>DMS_SensibilityBlockerHigh</HediffDef>
    </descriptionHyperlinks>

      <MarketValue>45</MarketValue>
```

### ThingDef:DMS_SynthFormingPod — gestation pod

來源：`1.7/Biotech/Defs/DMS_Frogman_Gestation.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="BuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_SynthFormingPod</defName>
    <label>gestation pod</label>
    <description>A biomatroid larva sealed inside the mineral pod it formed around itself after birth. Development continues inside: muscle bundles lay down over the frame, the outer seal cures, and the control lattice organizes itself. The mesonuclear substrate runs the whole process on its own, and needs no power, feedstock or supervision.\n\nThe pod swells as the larva matures, and flexes in wind. It cannot defend itself, and breaking it destroys the biomatroid inside. It is light enough to be uninstalled and carried elsewhere.</description>
    <thingClass>DMS.Building_SecondaryGestation</thingClass>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Synthroid/SynthForming</texPath>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Single</graphicClass>
      <shaderType>CutoutPlant</shaderType>
      <drawSize>(1.6,1.6)</drawSize>
      <shadowData>
        <volume>(0.3,0.25,0.3)</volume>
        <offset>(0,0,-0.15)</offset>
      </shadowData>
      <damageData>
        <rect>(0.1,0.1,0.8,0.8)</rect>
      </damageData>
    </graphicData>
    <size>(1,1)</size>
    <altitudeLayer>Building</altitudeLayer>
    
    <drawerType>MapMeshOnly</drawerType>
    <passability>PassThroughOnly</passability>
    <fillPercent>0.4</fillPercent>
    <pathCost>30</pathCost>
    <tickerType>Normal</tickerType>
    <rotatable>false</rotatable>
    <selectable>true</selectable>
    <useHitPoints>true</useHitPoints>
    <neverMultiSelect>true</neverMultiSelect>
    <drawGUIOverlay>false</drawGUIOverlay>
    <canOverlapZones>false</canOverlapZones>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>180</MaxHitPoints>
      <Flammability>0.4</Flammability>
      <Mass>25</Mass>
    </statBases>
    <building>
      <isInert>true</isInert>
      <claimable>true</claimable>
      <deconstructible>true</deconstructible>
      <destroySound>BuildingDestroyed_Metal_Small</destroySound>
    </building>
    
    <minifiedDef>MinifiedThing</minifiedDef>
    
    <tradeability>None</tradeability>
    <thingCategories>
      <li>BuildingsMisc</li>
    </thingCategories>
    
    <killedLeavings>
      <Artifuscle>25</Artifuscle>
    </killedLeavings>
    <modExtensions>
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_SecondaryGestation">
        <resultDef>DMS_MechCapsule_Frogman</resultDef>
        <gestationTicks>300000</gestationTicks>   
        <visualSizeRange>0.3~1.0</visualSizeRange>
        <anchorBottom>true</anchorBottom>
        <windSway>true</windSway>
        <randomPositionJitter>0.06</randomPositionJitter>
        <visualGrowthSteps>24</visualGrowthSteps>
        <claimByPlayerOnSpawn>true</claimByPlayerOnSpawn>
        <completedLetterLabel>Frogman formed</completedLetterLabel>
        <completedLetterText>The gestation pod has opened. The XM132 Frogman inside has reached its adult form, sealed and intact, and is holding in dormancy inside its capsule.\n\nA mechanitor must take control of it before it will respond.</completedLetterText>
      </li>
    </modExtensions>
  </ThingDef>

  
  
```

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="BuildingBase">

    <description>一次性定向熱蝕裝置，專為突破重型安全門、防爆閘門以及反器材使用設計。啟動後會產生劇烈的高溫金屬熱流，並透過聚焦噴口將能量集中於接觸點。數秒內即可在大多數工業級合金表面形成熔蝕通道。\n\n由於反應過程極不穩定，裝置僅能使用一次。操作員必須在部署後立即撤離安全距離，以避免高溫飛濺物與蒸發金屬造成傷害。</description>
```

### ThingDef:DMS_VaultConsole — security console

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Vault/DMS_Vault_Treasury.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="DMS_ConsoleBase">
    <defName>DMS_VaultConsole</defName>
    <label>security console</label>
    <description>The vault's access-control terminal. The sealed storage doors answer only to this console, and its credentials expired along with the unit that owned the place. Hack it to release the doors.</description>
    <graphicData>
      <texPath>Things/Building/Consoles/DMS_ConsoleSingle_Neutral</texPath>
      <drawSize>(2,2)</drawSize>
    </graphicData>
    <size>(1,1)</size>
    <hasInteractionCell>true</hasInteractionCell>
    <interactionCellOffset>(0,0,1)</interactionCellOffset>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>400</MaxHitPoints>
      <Flammability>0</Flammability>
    </statBases>
    <comps>
      <li Class="DMS.CompProperties_VaultConsole">
        <defence>1800</defence>
        <effectHacking>HackingTerminal</effectHacking>
        <intellectualSkillPrerequisite>5</intellectualSkillPrerequisite>
        <lockoutDurationHoursRange>2~4</lockoutDurationHoursRange>
        <showProgressAfterHackCompletion>false</showProgressAfterHackCompletion>
        <notHackedInspectString>Hack to release the sealed storage doors.</notHackedInspectString>
        <hackedInspectString>Storage doors released.</hackedInspectString>
        <hackedMessage>{HACKER_labelShort} has finished hacking {SUBJECT_labelNoParenthesisDef}.</hackedMessage>
        <hackedLetterLabel>Storage doors released</hackedLetterLabel>
        
        <hackedLetterText>Someone has broken into the vault's access-control system. The sealed storage doors are open.</hackedLetterText>
        <hackedLetterDef>PositiveEvent</hackedLetterDef>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>

  
  
```

### ThingDef:DMS_VaultElevator — freight elevator

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Vault/DMS_Vault_Portal.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="BuildingBase" Name="DMS_ElevatorBase">
    <defName>DMS_VaultElevator</defName>
    <label>freight elevator</label>
    <designatorDropdown>DMS_VaultElevators</designatorDropdown>
    <description>The entrance to a buried military storage vault. The lift still has power, but its controls are locked. Hack it to bring the car up.</description>
    <thingClass>DMS.Building_VaultElevator</thingClass>
    <size>(5,5)</size>
    <rotatable>true</rotatable>
    <useHitPoints>false</useHitPoints>
    <destroyable>false</destroyable>
    <tickerType>Normal</tickerType>
    <canOverlapZones>false</canOverlapZones>
    <terrainAffordanceNeeded>Heavy</terrainAffordanceNeeded>
    <altitudeLayer>FloorEmplacement</altitudeLayer>
    <fillPercent>0</fillPercent>
    <passability>PassThroughOnly</passability>
    <holdsRoof>true</holdsRoof>
    <graphicData>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Multi</graphicClass>
      <texPath>Things/Building/Elevator/building</texPath>
      <drawSize>(5,5)</drawSize>
    </graphicData>
    <statBases>
      <Flammability>0</Flammability>
    </statBases>
    
    <designationCategory>FFF_DevCategory</designationCategory>
    <building>
      <isEdifice>true</isEdifice>
      <deconstructible>false</deconstructible>
      <isTargetable>false</isTargetable>
      <isInert>true</isInert>
      <claimable>false</claimable>
      <expandHomeArea>false</expandHomeArea>
      <neverBuildable>true</neverBuildable>
    </building>
    <portal>
      <pocketMapGenerator>DMS_MilitaryVault</pocketMapGenerator>
      <exitDef>DMS_VaultElevatorExit</exitDef>
      
      <pocketMapSize>130</pocketMapSize>
    </portal>
    <comps>
      
      <li Class="CompProperties_Hackable">
        <defence>39000</defence>
        <effectHacking>HackingTerminal</effectHacking>
        <lockoutDurationHoursRange>6~18</lockoutDurationHoursRange>
        <showProgressAfterHackCompletion>false</showProgressAfterHackCompletion>
        <notHackedInspectString>Hack to open.</notHackedInspectString>
        <intellectualSkillPrerequisite>4</intellectualSkillPrerequisite>
        <hackingCompletedSound>Hacking_Completed</hackingCompletedSound>
        <hackedMessage>{HACKER_labelShort} has finished hacking {SUBJECT_labelNoParenthesisDef}.</hackedMessage>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Sealable">
        <sealTexPath>UI/Commands/DMS_UnlockContainer</sealTexPath>
        <sealCommandLabel>Seal shaft</sealCommandLabel>
        <sealCommandDesc>Choose a colonist to permanently seal the lift shaft. Anything or anyone left below will be lost forever.</sealCommandDesc>
        <cannotSealLabel>Cannot seal</cannotSealLabel>
        <confirmSealText>Sealing the lift shaft is permanent. Anything or anyone left below will be lost forever.{0}\n\nAre you sure you want to continue?</confirmSealText>
        <sealedInspectString>Permanently sealed.</sealedInspectString>
        <cannotEnterLabel>Sealed</cannotEnterLabel>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Glower">
        <glowRadius>3</glowRadius>
        <glowColor>(217,178,73,0)</glowColor>
      </li>
      
      <li Class="Fortified.CompProperties_FacilityLockdownGate">
        <overrideWork>6000</overrideWork>
        <overrideSkillPrerequisite>6</overrideSkillPrerequisite>
      </li>
    </comps>
    <inspectorTabs>
      <li>ITab_ContentsMapPortal</li>
    </inspectorTabs>
    <modExtensions>
      
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_PortalLayout">
        <genStep>DMS_VaultStructure</genStep>
        <layout>DMS_MilitaryVault</layout>
      </li>
      
      <li Class="DMS.ModExtension_SealedGraphic">
        <sealedGraphicData>
          <graphicClass>Graphic_Multi</graphicClass>
          <texPath>Things/Building/Elevator_sealed/building</texPath>
          <drawSize>(5,5)</drawSize>
        </sealedGraphicData>
      </li>
    </modExtensions>
  </ThingDef>

  
  
```

Infrasound passes through walls and cover alike, so the burst reaches every living creature in its radius, friend or foe, wracking them with nausea and pain and sending many into a panic. ### ThingDef:DMS_ZeroPointGenerator — zero-point generator core

來源：`1.7/NewContent/Defs/Things_Building/DMS_ExplorationBuildings_Occultech.xml`

```xml
<ThingDef ParentName="BuildingBase">
    <defName>DMS_ZeroPointGenerator</defName>
    <label>zero-point generator core</label>
    <thingClass>Building</thingClass>
    <description>A complex device that punches a hole in real space through the controlled release of antigrain energy, drawing inexhaustible energy from the quantum fluctuations outside and condensing it into solid energy blocks for convenient storage and further processing.\n\nSince the rim generally lacks antigrain production technology, the device usually has to rely on ready-made antigrain warheads as the catalyst that starts it running.\n\nWhile powered, each antigrain warhead loaded as catalyst yields 25 units of solidified zero-point energy, one every 2.4 days. A single warhead keeps the core running for about a year.</description>
    <descriptionHyperlinks>
      <ThingDef>DMS_SolitaryZPM</ThingDef>
      <ThingDef>Shell_AntigrainWarhead</ThingDef>
    </descriptionHyperlinks>
    <tickerType>Normal</tickerType>
    <drawerType>MapMeshAndRealTime</drawerType>
    <graphicData>
      <graphicClass>Graphic_Single</graphicClass>
      <texPath>Things/Building/ZPM_Generator</texPath>
      <drawSize>(4,5)</drawSize>
      <drawOffset>(0,0,0.5)</drawOffset>
    </graphicData>
    <fillPercent>0.65</fillPercent>
    <pathCost>90</pathCost>
    <size>(3,3)</size>
    <rotatable>false</rotatable>
    <defaultPlacingRot>0</defaultPlacingRot>
    <statBases>
      <MaxHitPoints>1000</MaxHitPoints>
      <WorkToBuild>40000</WorkToBuild>
      <Flammability>0</Flammability>
      <Beauty>-10</Beauty>
    </statBases>
    <costList>
      <Plasteel>150</Plasteel>
      <Tungsteel>200</Tungsteel>
      <ComponentSpacer>6</ComponentSpacer>
    </costList>
    <researchPrerequisites>
      <li>DMS_Occultech_ZeroPoint</li>
    </researchPrerequisites>
    <constructionSkillPrerequisite>12</constructionSkillPrerequisite>
    <terrainAffordanceNeeded>Heavy</terrainAffordanceNeeded>
    <designationCategory>DMS_Category</designationCategory>
    <building>
      <claimable>true</claimable>
      <paintable>false</paintable>
      <destroySound>BuildingDestroyed_Metal_Big</destroySound>
    </building>
    <noRightClickDraftAttack>true</noRightClickDraftAttack>
    <comps>
      <li Class="DMS.CompProperties_ZeroPointGenerator">
        <thingToSpawn>DMS_SolitaryZPM</thingToSpawn>
        <yieldPerCatalyst>25</yieldPerCatalyst>
        
        <ticksPerUnit>144000</ticksPerUnit>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Refuelable">
        
        <fuelConsumptionRate>0</fuelConsumptionRate>
        <consumeFuelOnlyWhenUsed>true</consumeFuelOnlyWhenUsed>
        <fuelCapacity>5.0</fuelCapacity>
        <targetFuelLevelConfigurable>true</targetFuelLevelConfigurable>
        <initialConfigurableTargetFuelLevel>2</initialConfigurableTargetFuelLevel>
        <fuelFilter>
          <thingDefs>
            <li>Shell_AntigrainWarhead</li>
          </thingDefs>
        </fuelFilter>
        <fuelLabel>Antigrain catalyst</fuelLabel>
        <fuelGizmoLabel>Antigrain catalyst</fuelGizmoLabel>
        <initialFuelPercent>0</initialFuelPercent>
        <showAllowAutoRefuelToggle>true</showAllowAutoRefuelToggle>
        <functionsInVacuum>false</functionsInVacuum>
        
        <drawOutOfFuelOverlay>false</drawOutOfFuelOverlay>
      </li>
      <li Class="CompProperties_Breakdownable" />
      <li Class="CompProperties_Flickable" />
      <li Class="CompProperties_Power">
        <compClass>CompPowerTrader</compClass>
        <basePowerConsumption>5000</basePowerConsumption>
        <transmitsPower>true</transmitsPower>
        <soundAmbientPowered>ScannerLongRangeMineral_Ambience</soundAmbientPowered>
      </li>
      
      <li Class="DMS.CompProperties_SingularityGraphic">
        <shaderType>DMS_Singularity</shaderType>
        <arcShaderType>DMS_SingularityArc</arcShaderType>
        <glitchShaderType>DMS_SingularityGlitch</glitchShaderType>
        
        <offset>(0, 0, 1.26)</offset>
        <size>1.5</size>
        <horizon>0.8</horizon>
        <color>(0.45, 0.8, 1.0)</color>
        <arcColor>(0.5, 0.85, 1.0)</arcColor>
        
        <arcTargets>
          <li>(-0.45, 0, 0.5)</li>
          <li>(-0.72, 0, 0.27)</li>
          <li>(0.45, 0, 0.5)</li>
          <li>(0.72, 0, 0.27)</li>
        </arcTargets>
      </li>
    </comps>
  </ThingDef>

  
  
```

### ThinkTreeDef:DMS_AMO — 

來源：`1.7/Defs/Misc/ThinkTree_AMO.xml`

```xml
<ThinkTreeDef>
    <defName>DMS_AMO</defName>
    <thinkRoot Class="ThinkNode_Priority">
      <subNodes>
        
        <li Class="ThinkNode_Subtree">
          <treeDef>Despawned</treeDef>
        </li>

        
        <li Class="ThinkNode_Subtree">
          <treeDef>Downed</treeDef>
        </li>

        
        <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalLowEnergy" MayRequire="Ludeon.RimWorld.Biotech">
          <subNodes>
            <li Class="JobGiver_SelfShutdown" />
          </subNodes>
        </li>
        
        
        <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalMentalState">
          <state>PanicFlee</state>
          <subNodes>
            <li Class="ThinkNode_Priority">
              <subNodes>
                
                <li Class="Fortified.ThinkNode_ConditionalHasWeapon">
                  <onlyRanged>true</onlyRanged>
                  <subNodes>
                    <li Class="JobGiver_FleeForDistance">
                      <enemyDistToFleeRange>2.9~7.9</enemyDistToFleeRange>
                      <fleeDistRange>13.5~20</fleeDistRange>
                    </li>
                  </subNodes>
                </li>
                <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalCannotReachMapEdge">
                      <subNodes>
                        <li Class="JobGiver_ExitMapBest">
                          <defaultLocomotion>Jog</defaultLocomotion>
                          <forceCanDig>true</forceCanDig>
                          <canBash>true</canBash>
                        </li>
                      </subNodes>
                    </li>
                    <li Class="JobGiver_ExitMapBest">
                      <defaultLocomotion>Jog</defaultLocomotion>
                      <forceCanDig>false</forceCanDig>
                      <canBash>false</canBash>
                    </li>
              </subNodes>
            </li>
          </subNodes>
        </li>

        
        <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalMentalState">
          <state>BerserkMechanoid</state>
          <subNodes>
            <li Class="ThinkNode_Priority">
              <subNodes>
                <li Class="JobGiver_Berserk" />
                <li Class="JobGiver_WanderAnywhere">
                  <maxDanger>Deadly</maxDanger>
                </li>
              </subNodes>
            </li>
          </subNodes>
        </li>

        
        <li Class="ThinkNode_QueuedJob" />

        
        <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalOfPlayerFaction">
          <subNodes>
            <li Class="ThinkNode_Tagger">
              <tagToGive>DraftedOrder</tagToGive>
              <subNodes>
                <li Class="JobGiver_MoveToStandable" />
                <li Class="JobGiver_Orders" />
              </subNodes>
            </li>
          </subNodes>
        </li>

        
        <li Class="ThinkNode_Subtree">
          <treeDef>LordDuty</treeDef>
        </li>

        
        <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalPlayerControlledMech">
          <subNodes>
            <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalNotFormingCaravan">
              <subNodes>
                
                <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalRecharging">
                  <subNodes>
                    <li Class="JobGiver_GetEnergy_Charger" />
                  </subNodes>
                </li>
                <li Class="Fortified.ThinkNode_Condition_Wake" MayRequire="Ludeon.RimWorld.Biotech">
                  <subNodes>
                    <li Class="JobGiver_SeekAllowedArea" />
                    <li Class="JobGiver_GetEnergy_Charger" />
                    <li Class="JobGiver_Work">
                      <emergency>true</emergency>
                    </li>
                    <li Class="JobGiver_Work" />
                  </subNodes>
                </li>
                
                <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalWorkMode" MayRequire="Ludeon.RimWorld.Biotech">
                  <workMode>Work</workMode>
                  <subNodes>
                    <li Class="JobGiver_SeekAllowedArea" />
                    <li Class="JobGiver_GetEnergy_Charger" />
                    <li Class="JobGiver_Work">
                      <emergency>true</emergency>
                    </li>
                    <li Class="JobGiver_Work" />
                    <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalWorkMech">                      
                      <invert>true</invert>
                      <subNodes>
                        <li Class="JobGiver_AIFightEnemies">
                          <targetAcquireRadius>65</targetAcquireRadius>
                          <targetKeepRadius>72</targetKeepRadius>
                        </li>
                        <li Class="ThinkNode_Tagger">
                          <tagToGive>MiscWork</tagToGive>
                          <subNodes>
                            <li Class="JobGiver_WanderColony">
                              <maxDanger>Deadly</maxDanger>
                              <reportStringOverride TKey="ReportStringPatrolling">Patrolling.</reportStringOverride>
                            </li>
                          </subNodes>
                        </li>
                      </subNodes>
                    </li>
                  </subNodes>
                </li>
                <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalWorkMode" MayRequire="Ludeon.RimWorld.Biotech">
                  <workMode>SelfShutdown</workMode>
                  <subNodes>
                    <li Class="JobGiver_SeekAllowedArea" />
                    <li Class="JobGiver_SelfShutdown" />
                  </subNodes>
                </li>
                <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalWorkMode" MayRequire="Ludeon.RimWorld.Biotech">
                  <workMode>Recharge</workMode>
                  <subNodes>
                    <li Class="JobGiver_SeekAllowedArea" />
                    <li Class="JobGiver_GetEnergy_Charger" />
                    <li Class="JobGiver_GetEnergy_SelfShutdown">
                      <forced>true</forced>
                    </li>
                  </subNodes>
                </li>
                <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalWorkMode" MayRequire="Ludeon.RimWorld.Biotech">
                  <workMode>Escort</workMode>
                  <subNodes>
                    <li Class="JobGiver_ExitMapFollowOverseer" />
                    <li Class="JobGiver_AIDefendOverseer" />
                    <li Class="JobGiver_AIFollowOverseer" />
                    <li Class="JobGiver_AIWaitWithOverseer" />
                    <li Class="JobGiver_WanderOverseer" />
                  </subNodes>
                </li>

              </subNodes>
            </li>
          </subNodes>
        </li>

        
        <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalPlayerControlledMech">
          <invert>true</invert>
          <subNodes>
            
            <li Class="JobGiver_AIFightEnemies">
              <targetAcquireRadius>45</targetAcquireRadius>
              <targetKeepRadius>60</targetKeepRadius>
            </li>
            
            <li Class="Fortified.ThinkNode_ConditionalHasWeapon">
              <onlyRanged>true</onlyRanged>
              <subNodes>
                <li Class="JobGiver_FleeForDistance">
                  <enemyDistToFleeRange>2.9~7.9</enemyDistToFleeRange>
                  <fleeDistRange>13.5~20</fleeDistRange>
                </li>
              </subNodes>
            </li>
            
            <li Class="Fortified.ThinkNode_ConditionalHasWeapon">
              <invert>true</invert>
              <subNodes>
                <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalCannotReachMapEdge">
                  <subNodes>
                    <li Class="JobGiver_ExitMapBest">
                      <defaultLocomotion>Jog</defaultLocomotion>
                      <forceCanDig>true</forceCanDig>
                      <canBash>true</canBash>
                    </li>
                  </subNodes>
                </li>
                <li Class="JobGiver_ExitMapBest">
                  <defaultLocomotion>Jog</defaultLocomotion>
                  <forceCanDig>false</forceCanDig>
                  <canBash>false</canBash>
                </li>
              </subNodes>
            </li>
          </subNodes>
        </li>
        
        <li Class="ThinkNode_ConditionalPlayerControlledMech">
          <subNodes>
            <li Class="ThinkNode_Tagger">
              <tagToGive>Idle</tagToGive>
              <subNodes>
                <li Class="JobGiver_WanderColony">
                  <maxDanger>None</maxDanger>
                </li>
              </subNodes>
            </li>
          </subNodes>
        </li>
        
        <li Class="ThinkNode_Tagger">
          <tagToGive>Idle</tagToGive>
          <subNodes>
            <li Class="JobGiver_WanderAnywhere">
              <maxDanger>Deadly</maxDanger>
            </li>
          </subNodes>
        </li>
        
        <li Class="JobGiver_IdleError" />
      </subNodes>
    </thinkRoot>
  </ThinkTreeDef>

```

```xml
<ThinkTreeDef>

          <treeDef>Despawned</treeDef>

                          <triggerRadiusFactor>1.4</triggerRadiusFactor>

                        <li Class="DMS.JobGiver_AICarrierStandoff">
```

```diff
+    <description>Gestate a Dogge Automatroid, a four-legged machine gun platform. The synthetic muscle bundles in its limbs give it uncommon cross-country mobility, and its low profile suits it to providing accompanying fire across open ground - it is usually used to mop up routed enemies and for counter-guerrilla work.\n\nIt keeps both an auto-engaging fixed machine gun turret and a separate weapon hardpoint that will take a flamethrower for close work, and it moves fast enough to keep pace with any advance. Culturing the synthetic muscle is expensive, its plating only handles fragments and small calibers, and the hardpoint will not accept a long-barrelled weapon. The Dogge is well suited to running down fast-moving light guerrillas and escaping prisoners, and it can also carry anti-tank rockets to punch above its weight in street fighting.</description>

       <DMS_Mech_Dogge>1</DMS_Mech_Dogge>
```
